t: Helicopters over Hong Kong, 1998
tz: 1998 年香港上空嘅直升機
d: Helicopters join the sim: GFS S-70 and S-76 from Kai Tak's south apron, the Macau shuttle from Shun Tak and a Peninsula Hotel rooftop helipad.
dz: 直升機加入模擬器：啟德南停機坪嘅政府飛行服務隊 S-70 同 S-76、信德往澳門穿梭機，同半島酒店天台直升機坪。
k: helicopters Hong Kong 1998 Government Flying Service Kai Tak helipad Shun Tak heliport Peninsula helipad Sikorsky S-76 Black Hawk flight simulator Kai Tak
x: Helicopters now work Hong Kong's skies in the sim. The Government Flying Service flies from its pads at Kai Tak, a Macau shuttle runs from Shun Tak, and a hotel helicopter tours the harbour. What is new Two helipads on the Kai Tak south apron, beside the flight services building, with a Black Hawk and an S-76 that lift off, fly a sortie over Kowloon Bay and come back. Two more helicopters stand parked beside the building. Shun Tak Heliport at Sheung Wan, on the roof of the Macau ferry terminal. Two S-76 take turns: one leaves for the west past Lantau while the other arrives. A helipad on the roof of the Peninsula Hotel tower in Tsim Sha Tsui, with a helicopter that flies a sightseeing loop over the harbour. The rotors spin up before lift-off and spin down after landing. Wheels fold away on the S-76. Lights show at night. Helicopters appear on the map as round blue dots. The shuttle and hotel flights stay on the ground in a typhoon, a storm, fog or low cloud, and the Government Flying Service stays on the ground in a typhoon. The Government Flying Service pads on the south apron. A Black Hawk climbs away from the apron. The Macau shuttle leaves Shun Tak. The rooftop helipad at the Peninsula. The hotel helicopter on its harbour loop. What the research found The Government Flying Service (GFS) moved into new premises on the Kai Tak south apron from August 1992 and took over from the Royal Hong Kong Auxiliary Air Force on 1 April 1993. Its 1997 fleet was 6 S-76 and 3 S-70 helicopters and 2 King Air aeroplanes. It moved to Chek Lap Kok with the new airport in 1998. The Macau shuttle began in November 1990 with Bell 222 helicopters. Three S-76C replaced them from 1997. Its Hong Kong pad, on the ferry terminal at Shun Tak Centre, was built in 1986. The Peninsula's rooftop helipad was certified in 1994. The RAF Wessex of 28 Squadron left Kai Tak when the squadron disbanded in June 1997, so none are in the sim. The full notes and sources are in docs/helicopters.md in the repository. What is made up Liveries, flight routes and times. The shuttle goes out and back in 1,300 seconds of sim time, and helicopters vanish when they are 30 km away. The height of the Shun Tak pad. What did not change The helicopters run on the sim clock, so rewind and fast-forward still work. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 直升機而家喺模擬器入面飛嚟飛去。政府飛行服務隊由啟德嘅直升機坪出發，有直升機由上環信德中心往返澳門，仲有酒店嘅直升機喺維港上空觀光。 有咩新嘢 啟德南停機坪、飛行服務大樓旁邊有兩個直升機坪，一架黑鷹同一架 S-76 會起飛，喺九龍灣上空飛一轉再返嚟。大樓旁邊仲泊咗另外兩架直升機。 上環信德中心直升機場，喺港澳碼頭嘅天台。兩架 S-76 輪流飛：一架向西飛過大嶼山，另一架同時返嚟降落。 尖沙咀半島酒店大樓天台有直升機坪，有一架直升機喺維港上空飛觀光路線。 起飛前旋翼會轉起上嚟，降落後會慢慢停。S-76 嘅輪會收起。夜晚會亮燈。 直升機喺地圖上係藍色圓點。颱風、風暴、大霧或低雲嗰陣，穿梭機同酒店直升機唔會飛；政府飛行服務隊只係颱風嗰陣唔飛。 南停機坪上嘅政府飛行服務隊直升機坪。 一架黑鷹由停機坪爬升。 澳門穿梭直升機離開信德。 半島酒店天台嘅直升機坪。 酒店直升機飛維港觀光路線。 資料搜集發現咩 政府飛行服務隊由 1992 年 8 月起逐步搬入啟德南停機坪嘅新院址，1993 年 4 月 1 日接替皇家香港輔助空軍。1997 年機隊有 6 架 S-76、3 架 S-70 直升機同 2 架 King Air 固定翼飛機。1998 年隨新機場搬去赤鱲角。 澳門穿梭直升機服務 1990 年 11 月開始，用貝爾 222。1997 年起由三架 S-76C 接替。佢喺香港嘅直升機坪建於 1986 年，位於信德中心港澳碼頭上面。 半島酒店天台直升機坪 1994 年獲批准啟用。 英國皇家空軍 28 中隊嘅 Wessex 喺 1997 年 6 月中隊解散時離開啟德，所以模擬器入面冇。 詳細筆記同資料來源喺儲存庫嘅 docs/helicopters.md 。 邊啲係虛構 塗裝、飛行路線同時間。穿梭機喺模擬時間 1,300 秒內來回，直升機飛到 30 公里外就會消失。 信德直升機坪嘅高度。 有咩冇變 直升機跟模擬時鐘行，所以倒帶同快進照用得。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣預設都仍然降落到，冇操控嘅話仍然會墜機。
a: Red helicopters on the two helipads of the Kai Tak south apron, beside the flight services building.
az: 啟德南停機坪兩個直升機坪上嘅紅色直升機，旁邊係飛行服務大樓。

t: Kowloon Walled City, rebuilt from photographs
tz: 照相重砌嘅九龍寨城
d: Kowloon Walled City is rebuilt as one solid mass of 10 to 14 storey blocks with balconies, aerials, rooftop shacks, shop signs and tube-lit windows at night.
dz: 九龍寨城重砌成一大舊 10 至 14 層嘅樓，有露台、天線、天台棚屋、招牌，夜晚窗戶亮起光管燈。
k: Kowloon Walled City Kowloon City Kai Tak approach 1998 park shop signs TV aerials flight simulator Kai Tak
x: Kowloon Walled City is no longer a field of loose boxes. It is now one packed mass of interlocking blocks, with balconies, aerials, rooftop shacks and shop signs, drawn from period photographs. You see it as the jet turns onto final over Kowloon City. 10–14 Storeys roofs capped at 44 m 2.8 m Floor height narrow, uniform storeys Day / night Lit windows tube-light green at night One solid block The old model scattered separate boxes inside the walled area. The new one fills it in rows of blocks that touch on every side, so from the air the Walled City reads as a single mass with a ragged skyline. The outer blocks run 10 to 14 storeys. A few lower, older blocks sit inside. The whole thing stays under the 44 m roof cap, so it is still the same collision volume you can hit. The Walled City from above, one block among the apartment towers of Kowloon City. Walls with something on them Every outer wall is now covered in the things the photographs show: small windows on narrow storeys, cage balconies, air conditioners, painted and stained patches and rain streaks. Enclosed balconies and add-ons bulge out of the walls, and open shopfronts line the ground floor. The south wall from the road, with sheds and signs at its foot. Signs over the street Shop signs hang flat on the walls and stick out over the street at right angles. The vertical ones are printed on both sides. They carry real shop words in Chinese, such as dentist, pharmacy, noodles and clothes cleaning, on red, yellow, blue and white boards with no real brands. They are lit at night. Vertical and flat signs along the wall. The roofs The roofs carry forests of TV aerials, water tanks, plants and shacks of timber, tin and plastic sheet, and low sheds stand along the foot of the walls, most of them on the south side. The aerials are the part you notice first from the cockpit. Water tanks, shacks and aerials on the flat roofs. The aerials with the approach beyond. At night Most windows show tube light in green, white and warm yellow, the shopfronts glow along the street, and the signs light up. From the approach at night the Walled City is one of the brightest patches on the Kowloon side. The south wall at night. The same view at night. Before 1994, or the park The Walled City was demolished in 1993–94, and by 1998 the site was a park. The home screen option Kowloon Walled City as it stood before 1994 is on by default. Untick it for the 1998 park instead. The same site as the 1998 park.
xz: 九龍寨城而家唔再係散開嘅一個個盒仔。佢變咗一大舊互相扣埋一齊嘅樓，有露台、天線、天台僭建屋同舖頭招牌，照住當年嘅相砌出嚟。飛機喺九龍城上面轉入最後進場嗰陣，你就睇到佢。 10–14 層數 天台最高 44 米 2.8 米 每層高度 窄而一致嘅樓層 日 / 夜 亮燈窗戶 夜晚係光管綠色 實心一大舊 舊模型喺城入面撒咗一啲分開嘅盒仔。新嘅一排排咁將成個範圍填滿，每座樓四面都連住，所以喺空中望落去，寨城係一大舊，天際線參差不齊。外圍嘅樓有 10 至 14 層，入面有幾座較矮、較舊嘅樓。成個嘢都喺 44 米天台上限之下，所以碰撞範圍都仲係同以前一樣。 喺高空望寨城，夾喺九龍城嘅住宅大廈中間。 牆身有嘢睇 外牆而家貼滿相入面見到嘅嘢：窄樓層上嘅細窗、籠仔露台、冷氣機、油漆同污漬，仲有雨水痕。封閉咗嘅露台同加建部分凸出牆外，地下一排開放式舖頭。 喺馬路望南面外牆，牆腳有棚屋同招牌。 街上嘅招牌 舖頭招牌有貼牆嘅，亦有同牆成直角伸出街嘅。直掛嗰啲兩面都有字。上面寫住牙科、藥房、麵家同洗衣等中文字，用紅、黃、藍、白色嘅板，冇用真實品牌。夜晚會着燈。 沿牆嘅直掛同貼牆招牌。 天台 天台上面有成林嘅電視天線、水缸、植物，同用木、鐵皮同膠布搭成嘅棚屋，牆腳亦有矮棚，南面最多。喺駕駛艙望出去，最先望到嘅就係嗰啲天線。 平頂上嘅水缸、棚屋同天線。 天線後面就係進場航道。 夜晚 大部分窗都透出綠色、白色同暖黃色嘅光管燈光，舖頭沿街發光，招牌亦着晒燈。夜晚喺進場航道望落去，寨城係九龍一邊最光嘅地方之一。 夜晚嘅南面外牆。 同一角度嘅夜景。 1994 年前，或者公園 九龍寨城喺 1993 至 94 年拆卸，到 1998 年原址已經係公園。主畫面嘅選項 1994 年前嘅九龍寨城 預設剔咗，取消剔選就會見到 1998 年嘅公園。 同一個位置，1998 年嘅公園。
a: Kowloon Walled City from above: a dense block of grey and green buildings with a ragged roofline, surrounded by roads and taller apartment towers.
az: 喺高空望九龍寨城：一大舊灰色同綠色嘅樓，屋頂線參差不齊，四周係道路同較高嘅住宅大廈。

t: Terminal gate blocks, the nullah and the tank farm
tz: 登機閘口大樓、明渠同油缸區
d: Kai Tak's terminal gets protruding gate blocks for its jet bridges, the nullah crosses the apron under three taxi bridges, and the tank farm moves.
dz: 啟德客運大樓多咗凸出嘅登機閘口大樓，明渠喺三條滑行橋底下橫過停機坪，油缸區亦搬咗位。
k: Kai Tak terminal jet bridges Kai Tak nullah drainage channel taxi bridge fuel tanks apron Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Three pieces of the airport have been redrawn from a 1990s aerial photo and the airport plans: the shape of the passenger terminal, the drainage channel across the apron, and the fuel tank farm. From over Kowloon City, looking out toward the harbour: the terminal, the tank farm and the nullah. The terminal is no longer a box The pier used to be one long rectangle. The apron face of the slab is now set back, and lower gate blocks stick out from it to the stand line. The jet bridges come out of these blocks. South-west end : a long gate block with the jet bridges of stands 1 to 4. The control tower stays on the slab behind it. Stand 5 : a small gate pod of its own. North-east end : a second long gate block for stands 6 to 8, then the main terminal block. Each gate block has a glazed lounge band at jet bridge level, lit at night, over a dark ground floor. The south-west gate block and stands 1 to 4. Stand 5's pod, the set-back slab, and the north-east gate block. The nullah across the apron The storm-water channel now crosses the apron. It comes out from under the north-east end of the terminal and runs parallel to the runway, between the stands and the maintenance apron. An open walled channel, cut into the apron, with water, grass verges and a railing on both sides. Three taxi bridges cross it, with yellow-and-black kerbs and yellow edge lines. It widens into a grassed oval basin, then goes into a culvert under the cargo apron. The culvert comes out through a headwall at the head of the inlet. The open channel and its verges are not tarmac. A jet that taxis into it is off the pavement, like the grass: it stops at the edge at walking pace and crashes at speed. Taxi over the bridges. The open stretches and the taxi bridges. Where it comes out from under the terminal. The outfall at the head of the inlet. The tank farm The fuel tanks have moved to where the aerial photo shows them: just past the north-east end of the terminal, on its landside half and in line with the building. There are now two rows inside a low bund: three big, squat tanks on the apron side and four slimmer, taller tanks behind them toward the road. The low white building beyond them has been moved clear so they can be seen from Kowloon City. The tank farm from the landside. Sources: a 1990s aerial photo of Kai Tak, the Hong Kong Kai Tak Airport map, Technocratic Aviation's Kai Tak plan and the World Flyer plan at Kai Tak Sports Park.
xz: 根據一張 1990 年代嘅航空相同機場平面圖，重畫咗機場三樣嘢：客運大樓嘅形狀、橫過停機坪嘅排水明渠，同埋油缸區。 喺九龍城上空望出海港：客運大樓、油缸區同明渠。 客運大樓唔再係一個盒 以前嘅客運廊係一個長方形。而家大樓向停機坪嗰面退後咗，再有較矮嘅登機閘口大樓凸出到停機位線。登機橋就由呢啲閘口大樓伸出去。 西南端 ：一座長嘅閘口大樓，有 1 至 4 號停機位嘅登機橋。控制塔仍然喺後面嘅主樓頂。 5 號停機位 ：有自己一個細閘口間。 東北端 ：另一座長閘口大樓，有 6 至 8 號停機位，之後就係客運大樓主座。 每座閘口大樓喺登機橋高度都有一條玻璃候機室橫帶，夜晚會著燈，下面係深色嘅地下。 西南閘口大樓同 1 至 4 號停機位。 5 號位閘口間、退後嘅主樓，同東北閘口大樓。 橫過停機坪嘅明渠 雨水明渠而家橫過停機坪。佢由客運大樓東北端底下出嚟，同跑道平行，喺停機位同維修停機坪之間流過。 一條切入停機坪嘅石屎明渠，有水、兩邊草地同欄杆。 三條滑行橋橫跨明渠，有黃黑相間嘅路邊石同黃色邊線。 明渠擴闊成一個種滿草嘅橢圓形水池，之後入暗渠，喺貨運停機坪底下穿過。 暗渠喺海灣盡頭經一幅渠口牆流出。 明渠同兩邊草地唔係停機坪路面。飛機滑行入去就等於離開咗路面，同草地一樣：慢行會喺邊緣停低，快速就會墜毀。請經滑行橋過渠。 明渠嘅露天段同滑行橋。 明渠由客運大樓底下出嚟嘅位置。 海灣盡頭嘅出水口。 油缸區 油缸搬咗去航空相入面嘅位置：客運大樓東北端過少少，喺大樓靠陸側嗰半，同大樓排成一線。而家有兩行，圍住一道矮堤：近停機坪嗰行係三個又大又矮嘅油缸，後面近馬路係四個較瘦較高嘅油缸。後面嗰座矮嘅白色建築物搬開咗，喺九龍城都睇得到油缸。 喺陸側望油缸區。 資料來源：一張 1990 年代啟德航空相、香港啟德機場地圖、Technocratic Aviation 嘅啟德平面圖，同啟德體育園「環遊世界」平面圖。
a: Kai Tak from above the Kowloon City side: the terminal with gate blocks on its apron face, the tank farm at its far end, and a channel crossing the apron.
az: 喺九龍城上空望啟德：客運大樓停機坪嗰面有閘口大樓凸出，盡頭係油缸區，一條明渠橫過停機坪。

t: The real road network, as it was in 1998
tz: 1998 年真實嘅路網
d: Fly Kai Tak's traffic now uses Hong Kong's official road network, with Route 8, the Hung Hom Bypass, Kai Tak and other post-1998 roads removed.
dz: 飛啟德嘅交通而家用香港官方路網，8 號幹線、紅磡繞道、啟德同其他 1998 年後嘅路已經拎走。
k: road network 1998 Transport Department Kwun Tong Bypass West Kowloon Route 8 Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The traffic now drives the Transport Department's own road centrelines instead of lines traced off a map picture. Roads that were built after 1998 have been taken out, so the network is the one you would have flown over in the last year of Kai Tak. West Kowloon: the reclamation is still empty, with only the 1997 expressway and the harbour crossing on it. What changed Accurate roads : every main road follows the surveyed centreline of each carriageway, joined through the junctions into long runs. No tunnels on the hills : tunnel sections are left out, so traffic no longer drives over Lion Rock or across the harbour on the water. Kowloon City streets : the streets under the approach come from the same data, which also places the shop signs and the asphalt there. Street lights : spaced a little wider, since each carriageway now has its own row. Taken out for 1998 Route 8 (Tsing Sha Highway and Stonecutters Bridge, 2008 to 2009). Tsing Yi North Coastal Road and Hung Hom Bypass (1999). Central-Wan Chai Bypass and the roads on the Central Reclamation Phase III and Tamar waterfront. Everything on the Kai Tak site: the new streets on the old apron and runway. The West Kowloon Cultural District streets, Cyberport Road, and streets first recorded after 2009, such as the Anderson Road estates. Kwun Tong and Kowloon Bay: the bypass and Kwun Tong Road, with nothing built on the airport side. At night the street lights trace the 1998 main roads. Source: Road Network Data of Hong Kong (Transport Department Intelligent Road Network, File Geodatabase by Esri China (HK)). Rebuild it with python3 tools/roads.py .
xz: 而家啲車行嘅係運輸署自己嘅道路中線，唔再係由地圖圖片描出嚟嘅線。1998 年之後先起嘅路已經拎走，所以個路網就係啟德最後一年你飛過嘅嗰個。 西九龍：填海區仲係空嘅，上面得 1997 年嘅快速公路同過海隧道。 改咗乜 準確嘅路 ：每條主要道路都跟住每條行車道實測嘅中線，喺路口接駁成長段。 山上面冇隧道 ：隧道段拎走咗，啲車唔會再喺獅子山上面或者喺海面行。 九龍城街道 ：進場航道下面嘅街道都係用同一份數據，招牌同柏油路面都係跟佢擺。 街燈 ：間距闊咗少少，因為而家每條行車道都有自己一行燈。 為咗 1998 拎走嘅路 8 號幹線（青沙公路同昂船洲大橋，2008 至 2009 年）。 青衣北岸公路同紅磡繞道（1999 年）。 中環灣仔繞道，同埋中區填海第三期同添馬海旁嘅路。 啟德舊址上面所有嘢：舊停機坪同跑道上面嘅新街。 西九文化區嘅街、數碼港道，同埋 2009 年之後先有紀錄嘅街，例如安達臣道嘅屋苑。 觀塘同九龍灣：繞道同觀塘道，機場嗰邊乜都未起。 夜晚啲街燈描出 1998 年嘅主要道路。 資料來源：Road Network Data of Hong Kong（運輸署智能道路網絡，Esri China (HK) 製作嘅 File Geodatabase）。用 python3 tools/roads.py 重新建立。
a: Looking south-west over Yau Ma Tei at the bare West Kowloon reclamation, with the expressway along its edge and Hong Kong Island across the harbour.
az: 喺油麻地上空向西南望，西九龍填海區仲係一片空地，快速公路沿住邊行，海港對面係香港島。

t: The Regal Kai Tak Hotel, rebuilt from photos
tz: 富豪啟德酒店：根據相片重建
d: The Regal Kai Tak Hotel rebuilt from photos and its roof plan: the L-shaped tower, glass bands, brick end walls, podium terrace, name signs and night lights.
dz: 根據相片同天台平面圖重建富豪啟德酒店：L 形主樓、玻璃橫帶、磚砌端牆、平台露台、招牌同夜燈。
k: Regal Kai Tak Hotel 富豪啟德酒店 airport hotel Prince Edward Road East footbridge Kowloon City Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The hotel across Prince Edward Road East from the car park has been rebuilt from photos and a roof plan of the real building, the Regal Kai Tak Hotel. It now carries its own name, 富豪啟德酒店, down the end wall and REGAL KAITAK HOTEL across the podium. From over the car park: the road face, the named end wall and the footbridge. The shape Plan : a long slab along the road with a wide wing running back to Sa Po Road at its north-east end, and both ends cut at an angle, as on the roof plan. Tower : continuous bands of dark tinted glass and brown spandrels on every long face, solid brick end walls with a column of small windows, and a deep brown cornice. Podium : brick, with a dark glazed band over the shopfronts, the hotel name across the road face and a planted terrace along the road. Roof : flat, with plant units and a round tank. The roof plan from above, with the footbridge to the car park. From the Kowloon City side, with the airport behind. The footbridge and the night The covered footbridge now meets the podium near its north-east end, as in the photos. At night the rooms light up at random and the name on the end wall and the podium glows. At night: lit rooms and the glowing name. Sources: photos and a roof plan of the Regal Kai Tak Hotel, and Gwulo's page on the Kai Tak Airport Hotel Footbridge.
xz: 停車場對面、太子道東另一邊嘅酒店，而家根據真實大廈富豪啟德酒店嘅相片同天台平面圖重新起過。端牆直寫「富豪啟德酒店」，平台前面橫寫 REGAL KAITAK HOTEL。 喺停車場上面望：臨街嗰面、寫住名嘅端牆同行人天橋。 外形 平面 ：一條長樓沿住馬路，東北端有一翼闊身嘅向後伸到沙浦道，兩頭都係斜切，同天台平面圖一樣。 主樓 ：每個長面都係一條條深色玻璃同啡色窗間牆，兩頭係實心磚牆加一行細窗，頂上有一圈深啡色簷口。 平台 ：磚砌，舖面上面有一條深色玻璃帶，臨街嗰面寫住酒店名，沿街有個種滿植物嘅露台。 天台 ：平頂，有機房設備同一個圓水缸。 由上面望天台平面，同埋去停車場嘅行人天橋。 喺九龍城嗰邊望，機場喺後面。 行人天橋同夜景 有蓋行人天橋而家喺平台東北端附近接駁，同相片一樣。夜晚啲房間隨機着燈，端牆同平台上面嘅酒店名會發光。 夜晚：房間着燈，酒店名發光。 資料來源：富豪啟德酒店嘅相片同天台平面圖，同埋 Gwulo 上面關於啟德機場酒店行人天橋嘅頁面。
a: A long dark hotel slab of glass and brown bands on a brick podium, its brick end wall carrying vertical Chinese characters, a footbridge leaving over the road.
az: 一座長形深色酒店，玻璃同啡色橫帶相間，企喺磚砌平台上，磚牆端面直寫中文字，行人天橋過馬路。

t: The Big Buddha at Ngong Ping
tz: 昂坪天壇大佛
d: The Tian Tan Buddha at Ngong Ping arrives: the bronze statue, its altar, steps and Po Lin Monastery, floodlit at night, on newly extended Lantau terrain.
dz: 昂坪天壇大佛登場：銅佛、祭壇、樓梯同寶蓮寺，夜晚有射燈，坐喺新延伸嘅大嶼山地形上。
k: Big Buddha Tian Tan Buddha Ngong Ping Po Lin Monastery Lantau Lantau Peak Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The Tian Tan Buddha now sits on its hill at Ngong Ping on Lantau Island. Finished in 1993, the 34 m bronze Buddha was five years old in 1998, and it is now a landmark you can fly out to in free flight. The Big Buddha facing north from Mok Yu Shan, right hand raised. The statue and the altar The Buddha : seated on a lotus throne, about 34 m tall, in dark bronze. The right hand is raised and the left rests on the lap, and the statue faces north. The altar : three round tiers modelled on the Temple of Heaven in Beijing, each with a white balustrade. The six devas : small bronze figures kneeling round the altar with their offerings. The steps : a straight flight down the north face of the hill to the plateau. Po Lin Monastery : red-walled halls under yellow tiled roofs on the plateau below. The Buddha is floodlit at night, so it glows on the dark hills of Lantau. Floodlit after dark. More of Lantau The sim's terrain used to stop just west of Lantau Peak. A new patch of terrain and aerial imagery now carries the island on to the west, so Ngong Ping, Lantau Peak and the hills to Tai O are all there. It meets the old terrain without a step, and the edges fade into the sea. Lantau from the east, with Lantau Peak and Ngong Ping beyond. Ngong Ping: the Buddha on its hill and Po Lin Monastery on the plateau. To visit, take off in free flight and head west-south-west, about 30 km from Kai Tak. The top of the statue is about 500 m above the sea, so keep well above it: it is a solid obstacle like any other.
xz: 天壇大佛而家坐喺大嶼山昂坪嘅山頂上。呢尊 34 米高嘅銅佛喺 1993 年落成，到 1998 年啱啱五歲，而家你可以喺自由飛行入面飛過去睇。 大佛喺木魚山上面向北方，右手舉起。 佛像同祭壇 大佛 ：坐喺蓮花座上，大約 34 米高，深色青銅。右手舉起，左手放喺膝上，面向北方。 祭壇 ：三層圓台，仿照北京天壇，每層都有白色欄杆。 六尊天人 ：細細尊嘅銅像，跪喺祭壇周圍奉上供品。 樓梯 ：一條直路由山嘅北面落返平台。 寶蓮寺 ：平台下面紅牆黃瓦嘅殿堂。 大佛夜晚有射燈照住，喺大嶼山黑沉沉嘅山上發光。 天黑之後亮起射燈。 更多大嶼山 模擬器嘅地形以前去到鳳凰山西邊就冇咗。而家加咗一塊新嘅地形同航拍圖，將成個島向西延伸，昂坪、鳳凰山同去大澳嘅山都有晒。佢同舊地形接得冇級，邊位慢慢沉落海。 由東面望大嶼山，遠處係鳳凰山同昂坪。 昂坪：山頂嘅大佛同平台上嘅寶蓮寺。 想去睇，就喺自由飛行起飛，向西南偏西飛，距離啟德大約 30 公里。佛像頂離海面大約 500 米，記住飛高啲：佢同其他嘢一樣係實心障礙物。
a: A seated bronze Buddha on a lotus throne atop a white three-tier round altar on a green hilltop, with a long flight of steps leading down.
az: 一尊銅佛坐喺蓮花座上，下面係白色三層圓形祭壇，喺綠色山頂上，前面有一條長長嘅樓梯落山。

t: Kwai Chung container terminals come to life
tz: 葵涌貨櫃碼頭活起嚟
d: The Kwai Chung container terminals get more ships, detailed quay cranes, offices, truck gates, freight stations, depots, yard traffic and working lighters.
dz: 葵涌貨櫃碼頭加咗更多船、精細嘅岸邊吊機、辦公大樓、貨車閘口、貨運站、吉櫃場、堆場交通同開工嘅躉船。
k: Kwai Chung container terminal Rambler Channel quay cranes container ships lighters Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The Kwai Chung container terminals under the IGS 13 approach now look like a working 1998 port. Container Terminals 1 to 8 line the Rambler Channel, with more ships alongside, more detailed quay cranes, the terminal buildings behind the stacks, and cargo moving everywhere you look. CT1 to CT8 from over Stonecutters Island. CT9 on Tsing Yi did not open until 2003, so it is not here. Ships at the quays, cranes at work More berths now have a container ship alongside. Each ship has lashing bridges between the bays, a breakwater on the foredeck, a radar mast on the wheelhouse and lifeboats in their davits. The quay cranes carry their operator's colours (Modern Terminals red-orange, HIT white, Sea-Land grey, ACT blue) and now show boom lacing, a walkway, a landside K-brace and a stair tower up one leg. The working cranes still load and discharge for real: the trolley runs out over a bay, the spreader drops to the stack, picks up a box and sets it on a tractor-trailer waiting under the portal. HIT's cranes working ships at CT6 and CT7. Lighters on the seaward side As in 1990s Hong Kong, some ships have a lighter tied up on the water side. Each lighter has its own derrick that swings a box from the ship's deck down into its hold, then swings back for the next one, while the quay cranes work the other side. A lighter's derrick lifting a box off the ship. Terminal buildings and yard traffic Offices with ribbon windows and the operator's sign on the roof. Truck gates : a canopy over the lanes, booths, barriers and lorries queuing in and out. Container freight stations with dock doors and trailers backed in. Maintenance workshops with big doors and spares on the hardstand. Empty-container depots stacked seven high, with top-lifters in the aisles. Reefer blocks : white refrigerated boxes no more than three high, plugged into steel racks. Yard tractors running the roads between the stacks, with and without a box. Behind CT3 and CT4: the office, the truck gate, the freight station and the empties depot. A reefer block in its racks, among the rubber-tyred gantries. CT8's backland, by Stonecutters Island. At night the yards are lit by high masts and the crane booms carry red obstruction lights. Try this Fly the IGS 13 approach and look left as you start the descent over Tsing Yi: the terminals are below you across the Rambler Channel. All the new buildings, cranes and ships are solid, so stay above them.
xz: IGS 13 進近航道下面嘅葵涌貨櫃碼頭，而家似一個真正運作緊嘅 1998 年港口。一至八號貨櫃碼頭沿住藍巴勒海峽排開，泊咗更多船，岸邊吊機更精細，貨櫃堆後面有碼頭大樓，周圍都見到貨物喺度郁。 喺昂船洲上空望一至八號碼頭。青衣嘅九號碼頭要到 2003 年先啟用，所以呢度冇。 碼頭泊船，吊機開工 而家更多泊位都泊住貨櫃船。每隻船嘅貨艙之間有綁紮橋，前甲板有擋浪板，駕駛樓頂有雷達桅，兩邊吊住救生艇。岸邊吊機用返各營運商嘅顏色（現代貨箱碼頭橙紅、HIT 白色、Sea-Land 灰色、ACT 藍色），而家仲加咗吊臂桁架、行人通道、陸側 K 形支撐，同埋沿一條腳上去嘅樓梯塔。 開緊工嘅吊機照樣真係裝卸貨：小車行出貨艙上面，吊具落到貨櫃堆，吊起一個貨櫃，放落喺門架下面等緊嘅拖架上。 HIT 嘅吊機喺六號同七號碼頭為船裝卸。 海側嘅躉船 好似九十年代香港咁，有啲船喺海嗰邊綁住一隻躉船。每隻躉船有自己嘅吊桿，將貨櫃由船甲板擺落自己個艙，再擺返去吊下一個，同時岸邊吊機就做緊另一邊。 躉船嘅吊桿由船上吊起一個貨櫃。 碼頭建築同堆場交通 辦公大樓 ：一條條窗帶，天台有營運商招牌。 貨車閘口 ：行車線上有上蓋，有崗亭、閘杆，貨車排隊出入。 貨櫃貨運站 ：有上落貨門，拖架倒車埋位。 維修工場 ：有大閘門，空地擺住零件。 吉櫃場 ：吉櫃疊到七層高，通道有吉櫃車。 雪櫃區 ：白色冷藏櫃最多疊三層，插住喺鋼架上。 碼頭拖頭 ：喺貨櫃堆之間嘅路上行，有啲拖住貨櫃，有啲空車。 三號同四號碼頭後面：辦公大樓、貨車閘口、貨運站同吉櫃場。 輪胎式龍門吊之間嘅一區雪櫃同鋼架。 昂船洲旁邊嘅八號碼頭後勤區。 夜晚堆場有高桿射燈，吊機吊臂有紅色障礙燈。 試吓 飛 IGS 13 進近 ，喺青衣上空開始下降時望左邊：碼頭就喺藍巴勒海峽對面你下面。新嘅建築、吊機同船都係實體，記得飛高過佢哋。
a: White quay cranes working container ships along a quay, with stacked yards and rubber-tyred gantries behind.
az: 白色岸邊吊機沿碼頭為貨櫃船裝卸，後面係貨櫃堆場同輪胎式龍門吊。

t: Apron mast lights off on clear days
tz: 晴天停機坪燈柱唔著燈
d: The apron floodlight masts' lamps and obstruction lights now switch off on clear days and come on at night, in overcast weather and in fog.
dz: 停機坪射燈柱嘅射燈同障礙燈而家晴天會熄，夜晚、天陰同有霧時先著。
k: apron floodlights floodlight masts obstruction lights weather Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The red floodlight masts over the stands no longer shine on a clear, sunny day. Their lamps and red obstruction lights now follow the same rule as the sim's other obstruction lights: on at night, and on by day only when the sky is overcast or foggy. A clear day: the masts stand dark. Rain and low cloud: the lamps come on. Try this Start Plane Spotter with the weather on Clear , then again with Rain or Fog , and compare the masts.
xz: 停機位上嘅紅色射燈柱，晴天日光底下唔會再著燈。佢哋嘅射燈同紅色障礙燈而家跟模擬器其他障礙燈一樣：夜晚著，日頭就只係天陰或者有霧先著。 晴天：燈柱唔著燈。 落雨低雲：燈會著。 試吓 天氣揀 晴朗 開始 觀機 ，再揀 落雨 或者 大霧 試多次，比較吓啲燈柱。
a: Red floodlight masts by the remote stands on a clear day, their lamps unlit.
az: 晴天時遠端停機位旁邊嘅紅色射燈柱，燈冇著。

t: Red floodlight masts over the stands
tz: 停機位上嘅紅色射燈柱
d: Tall red floodlight masts now stand between the stands across the Kai Tak apron, as in 1998 photos, with lamps and obstruction lights at night.
dz: 啟德停機坪而家有又高又紅嘅射燈柱企喺停機位之間，同 1998 年舊相一樣，夜晚有射燈同障礙燈。
k: apron floodlights floodlight masts Kai Tak apron stands Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Kai Tak's stands were lit by tall, slender red floodlight masts standing in the gaps between the parked aircraft, each with a bank of lamps on top. Period photos of the apron in 1998 show them rising between the tails. They are now in the sim, on every row of stands. A mast by the remote stands: a tapered red pole, a platform and a red frame of floodlights. Where they stand Each mast is 28 m tall, tapering from 0.8 m at the foot, with a service platform and a red frame of ten lamps that faces the stands. They stand at the nose end of each row of stands, in the gap between neighbouring stand boxes: along the pier at stands 1-8, and by stands 11-19, 21-26, 41-46, 51-57 and 71-81. They are placed clear of the wingtips, the jet bridges, the pushback tugs and the apron buses' lanes, so the ground traffic runs as before. Along the pier at stands 1-8, between each tug bay and the next jet bridge. At night After dark the lamps glow warm white and each mast carries a red obstruction light on top. The masts at night. Watch out The masts are solid, like the buildings. Clip one with a wingtip or the fuselage and the flight ends in a crash.
xz: 啟德嘅停機位由一枝枝又高又幼嘅 紅色射燈柱 照明，企喺停泊飛機之間嘅空位，頂部有一排燈。1998 年停機坪嘅舊相見到佢哋喺機尾之間聳起。而家模擬器每一排停機位都有。 遠端停機位旁邊嘅燈柱：收窄嘅紅色柱身、一個平台，同一個紅色射燈架。 企喺邊度 每枝燈柱高 28 米，底部 0.8 米闊、向上收窄，有一個維修平台，同一個面向停機位、有十盞燈嘅紅色燈架。 佢哋企喺每排停機位機頭嗰端、相鄰停機位方格之間嘅空位：沿住 1-8 號停機位嘅登機廊，同埋 11-19、21-26、41-46、51-57 同 71-81 號停機位旁邊。 位置避開機翼尖、登機橋、推機車同停機坪巴士嘅行車線，地面交通照舊運作。 沿住 1-8 號停機位嘅登機廊，企喺推機車位同下一條登機橋之間。 夜晚 天黑之後，燈會發出暖白光，每枝燈柱頂仲有一盞紅色障礙燈。 夜晚嘅燈柱。 小心 燈柱同建築物一樣係實心嘅。機翼尖或者機身擦到佢，飛行就會以墜毀告終。
a: Red floodlight masts with lamp frames standing past the noses of aircraft parked on the remote stands at Kai Tak.
az: 紅色射燈柱連燈架，企喺啟德遠端停機位飛機機頭前面。

t: The car park moves to the runway end, with the airport hotel and its footbridge
tz: 停車場搬到跑道嗰頭，加埋機場酒店同行人天橋
d: The Kai Tak car park moves to the runway end of the terminal frontage, with the airport hotel across Prince Edward Road East and its footbridge.
dz: 啟德停車場搬到客運大樓前面近跑道嗰頭，太子道東對面加咗機場酒店同佢嘅行人天橋。
k: Kai Tak car park airport hotel footbridge Prince Edward Road East plane spotters flight simulator
x: The car park has moved again, this time to match the 1990s aerial photos. It now stands on the runway half of the terminal frontage, between the terminal and Prince Edward Road East. The tank farm and the terminal block are at the far end. Across the road is the airport hotel, joined to the car park by its footbridge. From over Kowloon City: the car park, the hotel across the road, the apron and the runway. The hotel footbridge The airport hotel opened in 1982 on the far side of Prince Edward Road East. A covered, air-conditioned footbridge with a travelator carried guests over the road to the car park building, and through it to the terminal. The bridge hung from a single column in the middle of the road, with two cable stays to each side. In the sim the hotel has a generic name and a red rooftop sign. The footbridge over Prince Edward Road East, hotel on the left, car park on the right. A closer view from the roof The spotters' end of the roof is now near the runway end of the terminal, beside the control tower. From the Car park roof view, arrivals touch down in front of you, with the tower to one side and Hong Kong Island across the harbour. From the Car park roof view: a jet on the runway, the control tower to the right. Sources: 1990s aerial photos of Kai Tak, and Gwulo's page on the Kai Tak Airport Hotel Footbridge.
xz: 停車場又搬咗位，今次跟返九十年代嘅航拍相。而家佢喺客運大樓前面近跑道嗰半，夾喺大樓同太子道東之間。油庫同客運大樓主座喺另一頭。馬路對面係機場酒店，有行人天橋連住停車場。 由九龍城上空望：停車場、馬路對面嘅酒店、停機坪同跑道。 酒店行人天橋 機場酒店喺 1982 年開業，喺太子道東對面。一條有蓋、有冷氣、仲有行人輸送帶嘅天橋，帶住住客過馬路去停車場大樓，再經停車場入客運大樓。天橋由馬路中間一條柱吊住，每邊有兩條斜拉索。模擬器入面嘅酒店用咗一個通用名，天台有個紅色招牌。 橫跨太子道東嘅行人天橋，左邊酒店，右邊停車場。 天台望得更近 天台觀機嗰頭而家近客運大樓跑道嗰端，喺控制塔旁邊。用「停車場天台」視角，抵港航班就喺你面前著陸，一邊係控制塔，海港對面係香港島。 「停車場天台」視角：跑道上嘅噴射機，右邊係控制塔。 資料來源：九十年代啟德航拍相，同 Gwulo 關於啟德機場酒店行人天橋嘅介紹。
a: An aerial view of the car park along the runway end of the terminal, with the airport hotel across the road.
az: 鳥瞰沿客運大樓近跑道嗰頭嘅停車場，同馬路對面嘅機場酒店。

t: The car park roof view moves to the new car park
tz: 停車場天台視角搬到新停車場
d: The Car park roof spotter view now sits on the new landside car park, at the runway-end rail, with a clear view over the terminal.
dz: 「停車場天台」觀機視角而家喺陸側新停車場跑道嗰頭嘅欄河邊，望過客運大樓冇遮擋。
k: car park roof plane spotter spotter view Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The Car park roof view now puts you on the new car park, on the landside of the terminal. You stand at the parapet rail on the road-side corner of the runway end of the low roof, with the crowd of spotters behind and beside you. From the car park roof: over the terminal to the apron, the runway and the harbour. A clear view over the terminal The car park is now a little taller (eight decks on the low section, nine on the high one), so from the rail you look over the terminal roof to the stands, the runway and the harbour, and out over Kowloon City to the IGS turn. The spotters no longer stand in the camera's line of sight. Try this Start Plane Spotter and choose Car park roof from the Plane spotter menu, or press C until it comes up.
xz: 「停車場天台」視角而家會帶你去客運大樓陸側嘅新停車場。你企喺矮段天台跑道嗰頭、近馬路嗰個角嘅欄河邊，觀機人群喺你後面同旁邊。 由停車場天台望：越過客運大樓，見到停機坪、跑道同海港。 望過客運大樓冇遮擋 停車場而家高咗少少（矮段八層、高段九層），所以喺欄河邊可以望過客運大樓頂，睇到停機位、跑道同海港，仲可以望過九龍城睇 IGS 轉彎。觀機人群唔會再擋住鏡頭。 試吓 開始 觀機 ，喺觀機位置選單揀 停車場天台 ，或者一直撳 C 直到見到佢。
a: The view from the car park roof rail over the terminal roof to the apron, the runway and the harbour.
az: 由停車場天台欄河望過客運大樓天台，見到停機坪、跑道同海港。

t: 13 more parking bays from the Kai Tak plan
tz: 啟德平面圖多咗 13 個停機位
d: Checked against an unofficial Kai Tak plan: new stands 21-26, an east apron with stands 51-57, and south apron stands 71-81 now nose-in.
dz: 對照非官方啟德平面圖：新增 21 至 26 號停機位、東停機坪 51 至 57 號，南停機坪 71 至 81 號改為機頭向內。
k: Kai Tak apron parking bays stands east apron south apron airport layout Fly Kai Tak
x: We checked the sim's apron against Technocratic Aviation's unofficial Kai Tak plan and added the parking bays it was missing: 13 new stands in two places, and the south apron now parks the way the plan shows it. Kai Tak was always close to full in 1998, so more bays means a busier, more believable apron. The whole apron from above. The east apron is the new strip along the right-hand edge. Stands 21 to 26 The plan shows a second row of stands between lane D3 (the pier stands) and lane D2. That row was empty concrete in the sim. It now has six stands, 21 to 26 , each with a red stand box, a yellow lead-in from lane D2, a nose-wheel stop bar and a numbered plate. Aircraft park nose toward the terminal, tail to lane D2. Four hold a parked airliner and two are empty. Stands 21 to 26 between lanes D3 and D2. The remote stands 11 to 19 are on the far side of D2. The east apron: stands 51 to 57 On the plan the apron carries on past the maintenance hangars, out to the airport's east boundary road. The sim stopped at the hangars. The new east apron fills that gap with seven stands, 51 to 57 , lined up along the boundary, nose-in toward it, with a taxi lane behind the tails. Five hold a parked aircraft (a mix of passenger jets and freighters) and two are empty. The modern buildings that stood on that ground, and on the hangar strip, are gone, as they would have been in 1998. The interline building moved to the north-east end of the cargo terminal, where the plan shows a small building, so the new taxi lane is clear. Stands 51 to 57 on the east apron, beyond the hangars. South apron: nose-in The plan draws the south apron stands, 71 to 81 , with the nose toward the far edge and the tail to the taxiway. The sim had them the other way round. They are now nose-in, with longer lead-in lines from taxiway B4 and the numbers at the entrance. Stands 71 to 81, now nose-in. What did not change The pier stands 1 to 8, remote stands 11 to 19 and cargo stands 41 to 46 keep their numbers and positions, so the turnarounds, pushbacks and apron buses run as before. The new stands hold parked aircraft only. No traffic taxis to them yet. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, flying with no input still crashes, and the ground traffic never touches the parked aircraft. Stand numbers The stand numbers beyond 8 are the sim's own, not Kai Tak's real ones.
xz: 我哋將模擬器嘅停機坪同 Technocratic Aviation 非官方嘅啟德平面圖對照過，補返之前漏咗嘅停機位：兩個位置一共 多咗 13 個停機位 ，南停機坪而家亦都跟平面圖嘅方向泊機。1998 年嘅啟德差唔多永遠都爆滿，停機位多咗，停機坪就更加熱鬧、更加似真。 由上面望成個停機坪。右邊沿住邊界嗰條新長條就係東停機坪。 21 至 26 號停機位 平面圖喺 D3 滑行道（客運廊停機位）同 D2 滑行道之間仲有第二排停機位，模擬器之前嗰度係一片空石屎地。而家加咗六個停機位， 21 至 26 號 ，每個都有紅色停機框、由 D2 引入嘅黃色引導線、鼻輪停止線同編號牌。飛機機頭向客運大樓，機尾向 D2。四個泊咗客機，兩個係空位。 D3 同 D2 之間嘅 21 至 26 號停機位。遠端停機位 11 至 19 號喺 D2 另一邊。 東停機坪：51 至 57 號停機位 平面圖上停機坪一直伸過維修機庫，去到機場東面嘅邊界路。模擬器之前去到機庫就停。新嘅 東停機坪 填返呢個空位，沿住邊界排咗七個停機位， 51 至 57 號 ，機頭向邊界，機尾後面有條滑行線。五個泊咗飛機（客機同貨機都有），兩個係空位。 嗰幅地同埋機庫帶上面嘅現代建築已經拆走，好似 1998 年咁。轉機大樓搬咗去貨運站東北端，即係平面圖畫住一座細樓嘅位置，等新滑行線冇嘢擋住。 機庫後面東停機坪嘅 51 至 57 號停機位。 南停機坪：機頭向內 平面圖上南停機坪嘅 71 至 81 號 停機位係機頭向遠邊、機尾向滑行道。模擬器之前調轉咗。而家改成機頭向內，由 B4 滑行道引入嘅引導線長咗，編號牌喺入口。 71 至 81 號停機位，而家機頭向內。 冇變嘅嘢 客運廊 1 至 8 號、遠端 11 至 19 號同貨運 41 至 46 號停機位嘅編號同位置不變，所以周轉、後推同停機坪巴士照舊運作。 新停機位暫時只係泊住飛機，未有飛機滑行過去。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣設定下照樣降落，完全唔操作照樣會墜毀，地面交通亦都唔會撞到泊住嘅飛機。 停機位編號 8 號以後嘅停機位編號係模擬器自己定嘅，唔係啟德真正嘅編號。
a: Stands 21 to 26 between apron lanes D3 and D2, with red stand boxes, yellow lead-in lines, numbered plates and parked airliners.
az: D3 同 D2 滑行道之間嘅 21 至 26 號停機位，有紅色停機框、黃色引導線、編號牌同泊住嘅客機。

t: The car park moves to the landside of the terminal
tz: 停車場搬到客運大樓陸側
d: The Kai Tak car park now runs along the landside of the terminal, with footbridges, the clock and airport sign on its end wall and spotters on the roof.
dz: 啟德停車場而家沿住客運大樓陸側伸延，有行人天橋，盡頭外牆掛住大鐘同機場招牌，天台企滿觀機人士。
k: Kai Tak car park plane spotters car park roof clock terminal Prince Edward Road flight simulator
x: The multi-storey car park has moved. It now stands where it did in 1998: on the landside of the passenger terminal, between the terminal and Prince Edward Road, running alongside the terminal and joined to it by covered footbridges. The clock and the big HONG KONG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT KAI TAK sign have moved with it, onto the car park's end wall, and the plane spotters crowd the roof above them, as in the period photos. The car park runs along the landside of the terminal, with Prince Edward Road in front of it. Where it was, and where it is now Before, the car park was a square block off the far end of the terminal, out by the tank farm. The photos and the Kai Tak model tell a different story: a long, stepped building on the north side of the terminal, parallel to it, with the road on its other side. The new car park is about 300 m long and has two sections: a taller one toward the maintenance area and a lower one toward the runway. Stair and lift towers rise on the terminal side, and three footbridges cross to the terminal wall. The clock wall The clock and the airport sign, in English and Chinese, were on the end wall of the car park, not on the terminal itself. They are there now, facing the runway end and the road that runs past it. The clock wall, with the spotters along the roof edge above it. The spotters' roof The roof of the lower section is where the crowds stood. Cars park over most of the deck, but the runway end is kept clear and full of people, thickest along the parapets. The car park is now taller than the terminal, so from the roof you look out over it, across Kowloon City and the IGS turn, and down the apron to the runway. The stairwell head with its exit and caution signs is still there, behind the crowd. Across the low roof to the spotters at the runway end. Try this Start Plane Spotter and choose Car park roof from the Plane spotter menu, or press C until it comes up.
xz: 多層停車場搬咗位。而家佢企返 1998 年嘅位置：喺客運大樓嘅陸側，夾喺大樓同太子道東之間，沿住大樓伸延，用有蓋行人天橋連接。個大鐘同「HONG KONG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT KAI TAK 香港啟德國際機場」大招牌都跟住搬咗過去，掛喺停車場嘅盡頭外牆，觀機嘅人就逼滿上面個天台，同舊相一樣。 停車場沿住客運大樓陸側伸延，前面就係太子道東。 以前喺邊，而家喺邊 以前停車場係大樓遠端一座四四方方嘅建築，喺油庫附近。但舊相同啟德模型講嘅唔係咁：佢係一座長條形、分兩級嘅建築，喺大樓北面，同大樓平行，另一邊就係馬路。新停車場大約 300 米長，分兩段：近維修區嗰段高啲，近跑道嗰段矮啲。大樓嗰邊有樓梯同升降機塔，仲有三條行人天橋過去客運大樓外牆。 大鐘外牆 個大鐘同中英文機場招牌其實係掛喺停車場嘅盡頭外牆，唔係喺客運大樓度。而家佢哋就喺嗰度，向住跑道嗰頭同埋經過嘅馬路。 大鐘外牆，上面天台邊企滿觀機嘅人。 觀機天台 矮嗰段嘅天台就係人群企嘅地方。大部分位置泊滿車，但跑道嗰頭留空，企滿人，欄河邊最多。停車場而家比客運大樓高，所以喺天台可以望過大樓頂，睇住九龍城同 IGS 轉彎，再沿停機坪望去跑道。樓梯間連出口同小心標誌牌仲喺度，喺人群後面。 由矮段天台望去跑道嗰頭嘅觀機人群。 試吓 開始 觀機 ，喺觀機位置選單揀 停車場天台 ，或者一直撳 C 直到見到佢。
a: The end wall of the car park with a large clock and the Kai Tak airport sign, spotters lining the roof above it.
az: 停車場盡頭外牆有個大鐘同啟德機場招牌，上面天台企滿觀機人士。

t: The Kai Tak shop is open
tz: 啟德商店開張
d: Fly Kai Tak has a merch shop: checkerboard and IGS 13 tees, a Runway 13 cap, a 1998 patch, a pin, a poster, a mug and stickers.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 開咗精品商店：棋盤同 IGS 13 T 恤、13 號跑道帽、1998 布章、襟章、海報、杯同貼紙。
k: Kai Tak merch shop t-shirt cap patch enamel pin poster Fly Kai Tak
x: Fly Kai Tak now has a shop at flykaitak.com/shop : eight pieces of original merch built from the sim's own design system, the checkerboard, the IGS 13 approach and 1998 Kai Tak. The full range, filterable by type. What's in it Checkerboard tee (A$39): black, with the Kowloon Tsai checkerboard and 啟德 on the chest. IGS 13 approach tee (A$39): the 088° course, the 47° right turn and Runway 13, as a chart. Runway 13 cap (A$32): jade green, with the embroidered checkerboard mark. Kai Tak 1998 patch (A$12) and checkerboard enamel pin (A$14). Turn right at the checkerboard poster (A2, A$35), a final approach mug (A$24) and a sticker sheet (A$9). Every design is original and uses no real airline names or logos. How ordering works Coming soon The first run is being made. Each product has a Notify me button that emails contact@flykaitak.com; we will reply when it is ready to order. No payment is taken yet. When ordering opens, the button becomes Buy and goes to a secure Stripe checkout. On the home screen There is a new Shop button next to Blog at the top of the home screen, and a Kai Tak merch card under the coffee button. The blog header links to the shop too. Every order helps keep the sim free to fly. The Shop button and the Kai Tak merch card on the home screen.
xz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有商店，喺 flykaitak.com/shop ：八件原創精品，全部用返模擬器自己嘅設計：棋盤、IGS 13 進場，同 1998 年嘅啟德。 全部貨品，可以按類別篩選。 有啲咩 棋盤 T 恤 （A$39）：黑色，心口印九龍仔棋盤同「啟德」。 IGS 13 進場 T 恤 （A$39）：088° 航道、47° 右轉同 13 號跑道，畫成航圖。 13 號跑道帽 （A$32）：翡翠綠，繡上棋盤標誌。 啟德 1998 布章 （A$12）同 棋盤琺瑯襟章 （A$14）。 棋盤右轉海報 （A2，A$35）、 最後進場杯 （A$24）同 貼紙套裝 （A$9）。 所有設計都係原創，冇用任何真實航空公司嘅名或標誌。 點樣訂 即將推出 第一批貨製作緊。每件貨品都有 有貨通知我 掣，會電郵去 contact@flykaitak.com；有得訂嘅時候我哋會回覆你。暫時唔會收錢。開賣之後，個掣會變成 購買 ，帶你去安全嘅 Stripe 結帳頁面。 主畫面 主畫面頂部「網誌」旁邊多咗個 商店 掣，咖啡掣下面亦有張 啟德精品 卡。網誌頁頂亦有連結去商店。每張訂單都幫手令模擬器繼續免費。 主畫面嘅商店掣同啟德精品卡。
a: The Fly Kai Tak shop page, titled The Kai Tak shop, with 啟德 in large characters and the first products below.
az: Fly Kai Tak 商店頁面，標題係啟德商店，大字寫住「啟德」，下面係第一批貨品。

t: Boats along the seawall, not in the inlet
tz: 船沿海堤行，唔入水道
d: Boats pass right alongside Kai Tak's runway seawall again, as in the 1990s, but never enter the inlet under the taxiways to the south apron.
dz: 船又再沿住啟德跑道海堤經過，好似九十年代咁，但唔會駛入通去南停機坪嘅滑行道下面嘅水道。
k: Kowloon Bay harbour traffic junks seawall south apron
x: Boats in the harbour come right up to the seawall around Kai Tak's peninsula again, passing alongside the edges of Runway 13/31 as they did in the 1990s. The one place they never go is the water inlet under the taxiways to the south apron. The inlet to the south apron stays clear. What changed Junks and yachts moor along the shore in Kowloon Bay, and tugs, launches and police boats roam there, close to the seawall The junk moored off the runway is back, and so is the Boat in the harbour view from it No boat is moored in, or routed through, the inlet between the runway-side taxiway and the south apron A junk and yachts beside the runway seawall.
xz: 海港嘅船又再可以駛到啟德半島海堤旁邊，好似九十年代咁沿住 13/31 跑道邊經過。唯一唔會去嘅地方，係通去南停機坪嗰啲滑行道下面嘅水道。 通去南停機坪嘅水道保持冇船。 改咗啲咩 帆船同遊艇沿住九龍灣岸邊泊，拖船、嘩啦嘩啦同水警輪喺海堤附近行 跑道對開嗰隻帆船返嚟咗，「海港上嘅船」視角都返嚟 跑道側滑行道同南停機坪之間嘅水道唔會有船泊或者經過 跑道海堤旁邊嘅帆船同遊艇。
a: The water inlet between the runway-side taxiway and the south apron, empty, with boats out in the harbour beyond.
az: 跑道側滑行道同南停機坪之間嘅水道，冇船，遠處海港有船。

t: Wider spacing between taxiing aircraft
tz: 滑行飛機之間距離加闊
d: Taxiing aircraft at Kai Tak now keep double the gap on the taxiways. Departures queuing at the runway end can still close up.
dz: 啟德滑行中嘅飛機而家喺滑行道上面保持雙倍距離，喺跑道尾排隊起飛嘅仍然可以貼近。
k: taxiing ground control separation taxiway A Kai Tak traffic
x: Taxiing aircraft now keep twice the room they used to. Ground control used to let one jet close to about 9 m of another on the taxiways, which looked far too tight. The minimum gap is now about 18 m between moving aircraft, and about 10 m behind one that has stopped. Two jets on taxiway A near the Runway 13 end, holding the wider gap. What changed On the taxiways: the gap ground control keeps between taxiing aircraft is doubled, wingtips and tails included. Behind a stopped aircraft: the gap is doubled too. Waiting for take-off: departures queuing at the runway end may still close up, as before. At the stands: parking, pushback and the stand lanes keep their old spacing. What did not change Arrivals still have right of way over departures, and runway control works as before. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 滑行中嘅飛機而家會保持以前兩倍嘅距離。以前地面管制會畀一架飛機喺滑行道上面行到距離另一架大約 9 米，睇落太近。而家行緊嘅飛機之間最少相距大約 18 米，喺停咗嘅飛機後面就最少大約 10 米。 兩架飛機喺 13 號跑道尾附近嘅 A 滑行道，保持較闊嘅距離。 有咩改咗 滑行道上面： 地面管制喺滑行飛機之間保持嘅距離加咗一倍，翼尖同機尾都計埋。 停咗嘅飛機後面： 距離一樣加倍。 等起飛： 喺跑道尾排隊起飛嘅飛機仍然可以好似以前咁貼近。 停機位： 泊機、推出同停機位通道保持原本嘅距離。 冇改到嘅 降落嘅飛機仍然比起飛嘅飛機優先，跑道管制同以前一樣。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣設定下仍然降落到，乜都唔做仍然會墜毀。
a: Two airliners taxiing along taxiway A beside the Runway 13 threshold, well apart, with the terminal stands behind.
az: 兩架客機喺 13 號跑道入口旁邊嘅 A 滑行道上面滑行，距離拉得好開，後面係客運大樓停機位。

t: The checkerboard turn tightens at the end
tz: 格仔山轉彎尾段收緊
d: Kai Tak's checkerboard turn now starts gently and tightens to about 25° of bank over Kowloon City before rolling out on the runway.
dz: 啟德格仔山轉彎而家由輕微傾側開始，喺九龍城上空收緊到約 25°，然後對正跑道。
k: checkerboard turn IGS 13 steep bank Kai Tak approach Kowloon City
x: The checkerboard turn now tightens as you go, the way pilots flew it. It still starts about 2 NM out at roughly 650 ft and rolls out at roughly 140 ft, but the bank builds up toward the end instead of staying shallow all the way round. What changed First part of the turn: a gentle bank of about 6° past the checkerboard, for roughly 2 km. Tightening: over the next 600 m the turn steepens smoothly. Last few seconds: a 1,300 m radius, about 25° of bank at approach speed, low over Kowloon City until you roll out on runway heading. IGS course: the 088 course now crosses the runway centreline about 1.5 km out and points closer to the checkerboard. The steep part of the turn, seconds before rolling out on the runway. Flying it Start the turn when the "Checkerboard ahead" prompt appears with a light bank, then add bank as the hoops curve more sharply near the runway. The approach guide, the autopilot and the AI traffic follow the same curve. What did not change The entry and roll-out heights, the 3.1° glidepath and the 3,100 ft start over Tsing Yi. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 格仔山轉彎而家會越轉越急，同機師真實飛法一樣。仍然係大約 2 海里外、約 650 呎開始，約 140 呎對正跑道，但傾側會喺尾段加大，唔再成程都咁淺。 改咗咩 轉彎前段： 經過格仔山時輕輕傾側約 6°，大約 2 公里。 收緊： 之後 600 米轉彎平滑地變急。 最後幾秒： 半徑 1,300 米，以進場速度約 25° 傾側，低飛過九龍城，直至對正跑道。 IGS 航道： 088 航道而家喺大約 1.5 公里外同跑道中線相交，更加對準格仔山。 轉彎最急嗰段，幾秒後就對正跑道。 點樣飛 「Checkerboard ahead」提示一出就輕輕傾側開始轉，到接近跑道、指引圈彎得急啲嘅時候再加大傾側。進場指引、自動駕駛同 AI 航機都跟同一條彎線。 冇改嘅嘢 開始同完成轉彎嘅高度、3.1° 滑翔道，同喺青衣上空 3,100 呎開始。 所有天氣下自動駕駛照樣識降落，完全唔操作照樣會墜機。
a: A 747 in a steep right bank low over Kowloon City, with the runway just ahead.
az: 一架 747 喺九龍城上空大角度右傾，跑道就喺前面。

t: Maintenance apron now matches the flight apron
tz: 維修停機坪同主停機坪一樣色
d: The Kai Tak maintenance apron in front of the hangars now uses the same concrete colour as the main flight apron, with no dark patch or seam.
dz: 啟德機庫前面嘅維修停機坪而家用同主停機坪一樣嘅混凝土顏色，冇咗深色路面同接縫。
k: maintenance apron hangars apron Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The pavement in front of the hangars was a dark bitumen patch that stood out against the pale concrete of the rest of the flight apron. It is now the same concrete colour, so the maintenance apron and the main apron read as one surface. Before: a dark patch in front of the hangars. After: the same concrete as the main apron. What changed The maintenance apron in front of the hangars, round the bays and the fenced compound now uses the main apron's concrete colour The yellow stripe that marked the old edge of the dark patch is gone Hangars, the compound, floodlights and parked maintenance aircraft are unchanged Across the maintenance apron to the hangar doors.
xz: 機庫前面嘅停機坪本來係一塊深色瀝青，同其他停機坪嘅淺色混凝土好唔夾。而家佢改成同一種混凝土顏色，維修停機坪同主停機坪睇落就好似一塊。 之前：機庫前面有一塊深色路面。 之後：同主停機坪一樣嘅混凝土。 改咗啲乜 機庫前面、機庫門口同圍欄維修區周圍嘅維修停機坪，而家用主停機坪嘅混凝土顏色 以前標住深色路面邊界嘅黃線已經拎走 機庫、維修區、射燈同停喺度維修嘅飛機冇變 望過維修停機坪去機庫門。
a: The maintenance area on pale concrete that runs on from the main apron.
az: 維修區嘅淺色混凝土同主停機坪連成一片。

t: The checkerboard turn now starts at 650 ft, 2 NM out
tz: 格仔山轉彎而家喺 2 海里外、650 呎開始
d: Kai Tak's checkerboard turn now starts about 2 NM out at 650 ft and rolls out near 140 ft, with an orange-and-white checkerboard.
dz: 啟德格仔山轉彎而家喺約 2 海里外、650 呎開始，約 140 呎對正跑道，格仔山改做橙白色。
k: checkerboard turn IGS 13 Kai Tak approach 650 ft checkerboard hill Runway 31 missed approach
x: The checkerboard turn now matches how it was flown in 1998. You enter the right turn earlier and higher, about 2 NM from touchdown at roughly 650 ft, and roll out on runway heading at roughly 140 ft. The turn is wider and lasts about half a minute instead of fifteen seconds. What changed Turn entry: about 3.3 km before the threshold at about 650 ft (was about 1.8 km and 380 ft). Roll-out: about 470 m before the threshold at about 150 ft, close to the 140 ft pilots describe. Turn radius: 3.5 km (was 1.5 km), so the 47° right turn takes about 35 seconds at approach speed with a gentler bank. IGS course: the 088 course now crosses the runway centreline about 2 km out, so the inbound line runs a little south of the checkerboard, as on period approach diagrams. The checkerboard is now aviation orange and white, as painted on the hill at Kowloon Tsai, instead of red and white. The mast beside it matches. Runway 31 go-around: the tower now adds the missed approach turn, left heading 255 toward Stonecutters. Entering the turn, still well short of the checkerboard. Halfway round, with the orange-and-white checkerboard off the left wing. Flying it The "Checkerboard ahead, start the right turn" prompt, the approach guide hoops, the tower handoff and the autopilot all follow the new path. Start the turn when the prompt appears and keep the descent going through it. What did not change The 3.1° glidepath and the 3,100 ft start over Tsing Yi. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset on both runways, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 格仔山轉彎而家同 1998 年真實飛法一樣。你會早啲、高啲開始右轉，大約離着陸點 2 海里、約 650 呎，然後喺約 140 呎對正跑道。轉彎闊咗，由十五秒變成大約半分鐘。 改咗咩 開始轉彎： 跑道頭前大約 3.3 公里、約 650 呎（之前係約 1.8 公里、380 呎）。 對正跑道： 跑道頭前大約 470 米、約 150 呎，貼近機師講嘅 140 呎。 轉彎半徑： 3.5 公里（之前 1.5 公里），以進場速度轉 47° 右彎大約要 35 秒，傾側冇咁急。 IGS 航道： 088 航道而家喺大約 2 公里外同跑道中線相交，所以進場線喺格仔山稍為南邊經過，同當年進場圖一樣。 格仔山 而家係航空橙色同白色，同九龍仔山上油嘅一樣，唔再係紅白。旁邊支桅杆都改埋。 31 號跑道復飛： 塔台而家會加埋復飛轉向：左轉航向 255，飛向昂船洲。 開始轉彎，離格仔山仲有一段距離。 轉到一半，橙白格仔喺左翼外面。 點樣飛 「Checkerboard ahead, start the right turn」提示、進場指引圈、塔台交接同自動駕駛全部跟新路線。提示一出就開始轉，轉彎期間繼續下降。 冇改嘅嘢 3.1° 滑翔道，同喺青衣上空 3,100 呎開始。 兩條跑道喺所有天氣下自動駕駛照樣識降落，完全唔操作照樣會墜機。
a: A 747 halfway through the checkerboard turn, with the orange-and-white checkerboard on the hill to the left.
az: 一架 747 轉到一半，左邊山上有橙白格仔。

t: One bridge, a joined-up apron and a wider taxiway
tz: 一條橋、連埋嘅停機坪同闊咗嘅滑行道
d: Kai Tak's apron now runs into the south apron, one bridge crosses the inlet, and the taxiway tarmac widens near the Runway 31 end.
dz: 啟德停機坪而家連到南停機坪，水道上淨係一條橋，近31號跑道嘅滑行道停機坪闊咗。
k: south apron apron taxiway bridge inlet Kai Tak layout 1998
x: The airfield east of the runway now follows the 1990s Kai Tak plan more closely: the flight apron runs straight on into the south apron, only one bridge crosses the inlet, and the taxiway tarmac widens toward the Runway 31 end. What is new The apron tarmac continues from the main apron into the south apron, with no water between them. Tarmac now closes the head of the inlet beside the runway. Taxiway B4 runs the full length of the south apron, starting where it meets the main apron. The inlet has a single bridge, near its far end, linking the runway-side taxiway to the south apron. The second bridge is gone. Toward the Runway 31 end, the tarmac beside the parallel taxiway widens out over the water, tapering in at both ends. Taxiing aircraft can use all the new tarmac; the grass and the water stay off limits. The main apron now runs on into the south apron. Tarmac closes the head of the inlet. One bridge crosses the inlet. The widened taxiway tarmac toward the 31 end. What did not change Stands 71-81, the helipads and the flight services building stay where they were on the south apron. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 跑道東邊嘅機場佈局而家更貼近九十年代啟德嘅平面圖：停機坪直接連住南停機坪，水道上面淨係得一條橋，近31號跑道嗰頭嘅滑行道停機坪亦都闊咗。 有咩新嘢 停機坪由主停機坪一路延伸到南停機坪，中間冇水隔開。跑道旁邊水道嘅盡頭而家由停機坪封住。 B4滑行道沿住成個南停機坪行，由接主停機坪嗰度開始。 水道上面得一條橋，喺近尾嗰頭，連接跑道旁嘅滑行道同南停機坪。第二條橋已經拆咗。 近31號跑道嗰頭，平行滑行道旁邊嘅停機坪伸出水面闊咗，兩頭收窄。 滑行緊嘅飛機可以用晒啲新停機坪；草地同水面照樣唔准入。 主停機坪而家直接連到南停機坪。 停機坪封住咗水道盡頭。 水道上面得一條橋。 近31號跑道嗰頭闊咗嘅滑行道停機坪。 冇變嘅嘢 71至81號停機位、直升機坪同飛行服務大樓都留喺南停機坪原位。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣設定下照樣識降落，完全唔操控照樣會墜機。
a: Kai Tak from above: the main apron running on into the south apron, with the inlet beside the runway.
az: 從高空睇啟德：主停機坪一路連到南停機坪，跑道旁邊有水道。

t: The control tower is back on the terminal roof
tz: 控制塔返到客運大樓天台
d: The Kai Tak control tower moves to its real spot on the terminal roof at the runway end, rebuilt from period photos with outward-leaning glass.
dz: 啟德控制塔搬返去客運大樓天台嘅真實位置，跟舊相重建，控制室玻璃向外斜。
k: control tower Kai Tak tower terminal scenery tower view 1998
x: The Kai Tak control tower now stands where it really was: on the roof of the passenger terminal, at its runway end, where the pier meets the taxiway. It used to be a separate tower on an island in the apron. What is new The tower rises off the terminal roof: a plant storey with a band of windows, a dark storey set back beneath the cab, then the cab itself. The cab glass leans outward, wider at the top than at the bottom, so controllers could look straight down onto the stands. The plan is a rectangle with cut corners, as in period photos. A balcony rail runs round the foot of the cab, and a deep flat roof with a dark fascia overhangs the leaning glass. A red beacon and two masts sit on top. Satellite dishes and aerial masts stand on the terminal roof beside the tower. From the cab you look straight down onto the taxiway and Runway 13/31, with the harbour beyond, and along the pier and apron toward Lion Rock, as in period photos. At night the cab glows, as before. The cab sits on the terminal roof, its glass leaning outward. From the apron the tower stands above the terminal roofline. The Tower view looks down on the taxiway and runway. The other way, along the pier and apron toward Lion Rock. What did not change The tower is solid: fly into it and the flight ends. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 啟德控制塔而家企返喺佢真正嘅位置：客運大樓天台近跑道嗰頭，即係碼頭接滑行道嘅位置。以前佢係停機坪中間一座獨立嘅塔。 有咩新 控制塔由大樓天台升起：一層有一排窗嘅機房，喺塔頂下面有一層縮入去嘅深色樓層，再上面就係塔頂控制室。 控制室嘅玻璃向外斜，上闊下窄，等管制員可以直接望落停機位。平面係切咗角嘅長方形，同舊相一樣。 控制室底部有一圈露台欄杆，上面有個深色邊嘅平頂，伸出遮住斜玻璃。頂上有一盞紅色燈同兩支天線。 塔旁邊嘅大樓天台有衛星碟同天線杆。 由控制室可以直接望落滑行道同 13/31 跑道，後面係海港；另一邊沿住碼頭同停機坪望向獅子山，同舊相一樣。 夜晚控制室會好似以前咁發光。 控制室坐喺大樓天台，玻璃向外斜。 由停機坪望，控制塔高過大樓嘅天台線。 塔台視角望落滑行道同跑道。 另一邊沿住碼頭同停機坪望向獅子山。 冇變嘅嘢 控制塔係實心嘅：撞埋去就會墜機。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣設定下照樣降落，完全唔操作照樣會墜機。
a: The control tower on the terminal roof, with outward-leaning cab windows.
az: 客運大樓天台上嘅控制塔，控制室窗向外斜。

t: Follow Fly Kai Tak on Facebook and Instagram
tz: 喺 Facebook 同 Instagram 追蹤 Fly Kai Tak
d: Follow Fly Kai Tak on Facebook and Instagram at @flykaitak. Both are now linked from the home screen and every blog page.
dz: 喺 Facebook 同 Instagram 追蹤 Fly Kai Tak（@flykaitak），主畫面同每個網誌頁都有連結。
k: Facebook Instagram follow social media Fly Kai Tak @flykaitak
x: Fly Kai Tak now has a Facebook page and an Instagram account , both at @flykaitak . Where to find us facebook.com/flykaitak instagram.com/flykaitak On the home screen A new Follow Fly Kai Tak section sits above the share buttons on the home screen, with a link to each. The blog footer links to both too. Follow links on the home screen, above Share Fly Kai Tak.
xz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有 Facebook 專頁 同 Instagram 帳戶 ，兩邊都係 @flykaitak 。 喺邊度搵到我哋 facebook.com/flykaitak instagram.com/flykaitak 主畫面 主畫面分享掣上面多咗一個 追蹤 Fly Kai Tak 區，兩個平台各有連結。網誌頁底都連去呢兩個地方。 主畫面「分享 Fly Kai Tak」上面嘅追蹤連結。

az: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面，有去 Facebook 同 Instagram 嘅追蹤連結。

t: Harbour shipping follows the fairways
tz: 港內船隻跟返航道
d: Moving ships follow the Marine Department fairways and traffic separation schemes, one way and keeping right, while most harbour vessels lie moored or at anchor.
dz: 行緊嘅船跟海事處航道同分道航行制單向靠右行，港內大部分船就停泊或者拋錨。
k: shipping fairways traffic separation scheme Victoria Harbour Lei Yue Mun moored ships Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Ships in the harbour now go somewhere on purpose. Moving ships follow the real fairways and traffic separation schemes from the Marine Department charts, and most of the rest of the harbour's shipping sits still, moored or at anchor. Through traffic in Victoria Harbour, each ship with its wake astern. One way, keeping right Lanes follow the Victoria Harbour and Lei Yue Mun fairway, the Ma Wan and Western Fairway, the Castle Peak Fairway, Rambler Channel and the East Lamma Channel scheme Each fairway has a lane each way, and ships keep to their starboard side, so the two streams pass port to port Ships never turn round: they sail the length of the chart and re-enter at the far end Freighters, container ships, liners, junks and yachts use the lanes; junks and yachts keep to the outer edge Looking east along the fairway to Lei Yue Mun. Most ships are going nowhere Container ships and freighters lie alongside the Kwai Chung side, with tugs, and others swing at anchor in the western anchorages, all facing the same way Junks, yachts and launches are moored along the shore in Kowloon Bay and Causeway Bay Moored ships show anchor lights only and leave no wake Star Ferries still cross between their piers, and tugs, launches and police boats still roam
xz: 港內嘅船而家有明確去向。行緊嘅船跟返海事處海圖上嘅真實航道同分道航行制，港內其餘大部分船就係停泊或者拋錨，唔會郁。 維多利亞港嘅過境船隻，每艘船後面都有尾浪。 單向行駛，靠右行 航道跟維多利亞港同鯉魚門航道、馬灣同西面航道、青山航道、藍巴勒海峽同東博寮海峽分道航行制 每條航道雙向各有一條線，船靠右舷行，兩邊船隻左舷對左舷咁交會 船唔會調頭：沿住海圖行到盡頭，再由另一端重新入場 貨船、貨櫃船、郵輪、帆船同遊艇行航道；帆船同遊艇行喺航道外邊 沿航道向東望去鯉魚門。 大部分船都係唔郁嘅 貨櫃船同貨船喺葵涌一邊靠岸，仲有拖船；其他喺西面錨地拋錨，船頭全部朝同一方向 帆船、遊艇同小艇停泊喺九龍灣同銅鑼灣沿岸 停泊嘅船只亮錨燈，冇尾浪 天星小輪照舊喺碼頭之間往返，拖船、小艇同水警船照舊四圍行
a: Cargo ships under way in Victoria Harbour with wakes behind them.
az: 維多利亞港內行緊嘅貨船，船尾拖住尾浪。

t: Separate menus for flight, spotter and terminal views
tz: 飛行、觀機同客運大樓視角分開選單
d: Kai Tak's camera menu is now three: Flight views, Plane spotter spots and a new Terminal interior menu for the hall, immigration, arcade, gate lounge, stairs and entrance.
dz: 啟德嘅鏡頭選單而家有三個：飛行視角、觀機位置，同新嘅客運大樓內部選單，包括大堂、入境檢查、商店街、候機室、樓梯同正門。
k: camera views plane spotter terminal interior menu Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The single camera menu is now three: Flight views, Plane spotter and Terminal interior. Each list is shorter and easier to scan. Three view menus in the top bar, with the departures hall showing. What is in each menu Flight views: Cockpit, Exterior, Tower and Cabin seat Plane spotter: Kowloon City street, Prince Edward Road, car park roof, boat in the harbour, top of Checkerboard Hill, Lei Yue Mun (Runway 31) and The Peak Terminal interior: departures hall, departure immigration, shop arcade, gate lounge, ground floor and stairs, arrivals hall and front entrance Picking a view in one menu resets the other two to their titles, so you can always see which one is active. On narrow screens the Plane spotter and Terminal interior menus sit under More.
xz: 原本得一個鏡頭選單，而家分咗做三個：飛行視角、觀機位置同客運大樓內部。每個清單短咗，易睇咗。 頂部列嘅三個視角選單，畫面係離境大堂。 每個選單有啲咩 飛行視角： Cockpit、Exterior、Tower 同 Cabin seat 觀機位置： 九龍城街道、太子道、停車場天台、海港船上、彩虹邨後面嘅棋盤山頂、鯉魚門（31 號跑道）同太平山頂 客運大樓內部： 離境大堂、離境入境檢查、商店街、登機閘口候機室、地下大堂同樓梯、抵港大堂同正門 喺一個選單揀咗視角，其他兩個會返回標題，咁就一眼睇到而家用緊邊個。細畫面嘅話，觀機位置同客運大樓內部選單喺「更多」入面。
a: The top bar with three view menus while the camera stands in the departures hall.
az: 頂部列有三個視角選單，鏡頭企喺離境大堂入面。

t: South apron, helipads and inlet taxiways
tz: 南停機坪、直升機坪同海灣滑行道
d: Kai Tak's south apron with stands 71-81, helipads and taxiway bridges over the inlet, plus fuel tanks beside the terminal and bitumen at the maintenance hangars.
dz: 啟德南停機坪有71至81號機位、直升機坪同橫過海灣嘅滑行道橋，仲有客運大樓旁嘅油缸同維修機庫嘅瀝青路面。
k: south apron helipad taxiway bridge fuel tanks maintenance apron Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Kai Tak's south side is built: the south apron with stands 71 to 81, two helipads, taxiways that cross the water inlet on concrete bridge decks, fuel tanks beside the terminal, and bitumen on the maintenance apron. The south apron across the inlet from the runway. South apron and helipads Stands 71 to 81 along taxiway B4, with red stand boxes, number plates and a lead-in line to each stop bar Aircraft parked nose to the taxiway on most stands Two helipads with a white H, and a flight services building beside them Taxiways over the water The inlet that runs beside the runway is crossed by two link taxiways, A7 and A9 on the 1996 chart, each on a concrete deck with low parapets and piers into the water. Aircraft can taxi on the decks and the apron. Fuel tanks and maintenance apron Fuel tanks between the terminal and the hangars, and bitumen on the maintenance apron. The nine fuel tanks now stand between the passenger terminal and the maintenance hangars, as in the model and aerial photos. The flight apron round the hangars, bays and stripped aircraft is dark bitumen with a yellow edge line.
xz: 啟德南面起好咗：有71至81號機位嘅南停機坪、兩個直升機坪、橫過海灣嘅混凝土橋面滑行道、客運大樓旁邊嘅油缸，同維修停機坪嘅瀝青路面。 隔住海灣望過去嘅南停機坪。 南停機坪同直升機坪 沿B4滑行道有71至81號機位，有紅色機位框、號碼牌同通往停止線嘅引導線 大部分機位停咗飛機，機頭向住滑行道 兩個有白色H字嘅直升機坪，旁邊有飛行服務大樓 橫過海水嘅滑行道 跑道旁邊嘅海灣有兩條連接滑行道橫過，即1996年圖表上嘅A7同A9，各自喺混凝土橋面上，有矮護欄同打落海嘅橋墩。飛機可以喺橋面同停機坪上滑行。 油缸同維修停機坪 大樓同機庫之間嘅油缸，同維修停機坪嘅瀝青路面。 九個油缸而家企喺客運大樓同維修機庫之間，同模型同航拍相一樣。機庫、機位同拆機區周圍嘅停機坪係深色瀝青，加黃色邊線。
a: A long south apron with parked aircraft beside the water inlet, two taxiway bridges and two helipads.
az: 海灣旁邊停咗飛機嘅南停機坪、兩條滑行道橋同兩個直升機坪。

t: Inside the 1998 terminal: staff and signs
tz: 1998年客運大樓內部：職員同指示牌
d: The Kai Tak terminal now has a 1998 interior: check-in desks, departure immigration, a shop arcade, arrivals, signs and staff including armed security.
dz: 啟德客運大樓而家有1998年內部：登機櫃台、離境入境、商店街、抵港大堂、指示牌同職員，包括帶槍保安。
k: terminal interior signage security staff immigration Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The main terminal block is no longer an empty shell. Pick one of the new Terminal views and you stand inside a 1998 Kai Tak, built from period photos: yellow bilingual signs, red check-in desks, tiled floors, acoustic ceilings and a crowd of staff and passengers. The departures hall on the 1/F, with invented airlines on the desks. Where to look Departures hall : red check-in desks and flight boards that follow the sim's own schedule Departure immigration : the yellow "B" sign, booths and officers Shop arcade : bilingual shop signs along the pier corridor Gate lounge , ground floor and stairs , arrivals hall (the "Welcome to Hong Kong" banner, baggage claim and customs signs) and front entrance Departure immigration, with a security officer in blue. Staff and signs Check-in agents, immigration officers and gate agents work their posts. Armed airport security officers in blue uniforms and berets, carrying carbines, stand in pairs near immigration and the arrivals hall. Signs are yellow with black English and Chinese text, as in the photos. All airlines and shops are invented; there are no real names or logos. The shop arcade on the way to the gates. The arrivals hall on the ground floor. The interior is built the first time you pick a Terminal view and is only drawn while one is active, so it costs nothing in normal flying. Look around by dragging.
xz: 主客運大樓而家唔再係空殼。揀新嘅 Terminal 視角，你就企喺1998年嘅啟德入面：根據當年相片重建，有黃色中英雙語指示牌、紅色辦理登機櫃台、瓷磚地板、吸音天花，仲有一班職員同乘客。 1/F離境大堂，櫃台上係虛構航空公司。 去邊度睇 離境大堂 ：紅色登機櫃台，航班板跟返模擬器自己嘅時間表 離境入境檢查 ：黃色「B」字牌、櫃位同入境主任 商店街 ：碼頭走廊沿路嘅中英雙語店舖招牌 登機閘口休息室 、 地下同樓梯 、 抵港大堂 （「Welcome to Hong Kong」橫額、行李認領同海關指示牌）同 正門 離境入境檢查，旁邊有藍色制服嘅保安。 職員同指示牌 辦理登機職員、入境主任同登機閘口職員喺各自崗位工作。着藍色制服、戴貝雷帽、攜帶卡賓槍嘅機場保安成雙成對企喺入境處同抵港大堂附近。指示牌同相片一樣，黃底黑字，中英對照。所有航空公司同店舖都係虛構，冇真實名稱或標誌。 去閘口途中嘅商店街。 地下嘅抵港大堂。 內部喺你第一次揀Terminal視角先至建，而且淨係喺嗰啲視角先畫出嚟，所以平時飛行唔會食資源。拖動滑鼠就可以四圍望。
a: The departures hall with red check-in desks, flight boards and passengers.
az: 離境大堂，紅色登機櫃台、航班板同乘客。

t: Maintenance area moved to the chart position
tz: 維修區移到圖表位置
d: The Kai Tak maintenance area is repositioned to match the 1996 parking chart and airport plan: hangars, workshop tower, compound and offices turned to the chart angle.
dz: 啟德維修區按1996年停機坪圖同機場平面圖重新定位：機庫、工場塔、維修區同辦公樓轉到圖表角度。
k: maintenance area hangars 1996 chart Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The maintenance area has moved to where the 1996 aircraft parking and docking chart and the airport plan put it: a strip of hangars and aprons behind the terminal's north-west end, turned to follow the chart's angle instead of the runway's. The hangars, workshop tower and compound in their new position. What changed The hangars, workshop tower, interline building, fenced compound, blast fence and floodlights moved together and turned to the chart's angle Parked maintenance aircraft face the hangar doors again Hangar walls and the tank farm still block aircraft and the autopilot correctly Three maintenance office buildings were added from the chart The sim's terminal block and car park do not match the chart exactly, so the strip sits slightly further out than on the real plan to stay clear of them.
xz: 維修區已經移去1996年停機坪及泊位圖同機場平面圖所示嘅位置：喺客運大樓西北端後面一條機庫同停機坪，跟圖表嘅角度轉向，而唔係跟跑道。 機庫、工場塔同維修區喺新位置。 改咗啲乜 機庫、工場塔、聯運大樓、圍欄維修區、擋噴氣牆同泛光燈一齊移動，轉到圖表角度 停喺維修區嘅飛機再次面向機庫門 機庫牆身同油缸區仍然會正確阻擋飛機同自動駕駛 根據圖表加咗三座維修辦公大樓 模擬器嘅客運大樓同停車場同圖表唔完全吻合，所以呢條維修區要比真實平面圖再遠少少，避開佢哋。
a: Three hangars with open door bays beside a fenced compound.
az: 有圍欄維修區隔離嘅三個開門機庫。

t: Maintenance area: hangars and tank farm
tz: 維修區：機庫同油缸區
d: Kai Tak's maintenance area now has three hangars with lit bays, a workshop tower, a fenced aircraft compound, a blast fence, floodlights and a fuel tank farm.
dz: 啟德維修區而家有三個亮燈機庫、工場塔、有圍欄嘅飛機維修區、擋噴氣牆、泛光燈同油缸區。
k: maintenance area hangars tank farm blast fence Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The maintenance area is now built as a proper complex on the north-west edge of the airport, beyond the passenger terminal and running toward the cargo side, where the Kai Tak chart and the Sports Park site map put it. The hangars Three hangars stand along the back of the maintenance apron: a small one nearest the terminal, a big pale one with a skylight-striped roof and two lit bays, and a dark one with two lit bays and a roof of skylight squares. A ribbed workshop tower with lit windows sits between the first two, and each hangar has an arrow sign (an invented one, not a real company logo). Two aircraft are nosing out of the bays. The maintenance area from the apron side. The apron around them A fenced compound with a stripped-down 747 and yellow stands and loaders A red and white striped blast fence behind the last terminal stand A low interline-connections building with roof plant and a loading canopy Floodlight masts across the maintenance apron A fuel tank farm behind the main terminal block The fenced aircraft compound, with the blast fence and car park in the foreground. At night The hangar bays glow warm, the workshop windows light up and the floodlights come on with the rest of the airport. The hangar bays lit at night. All the new buildings are solid for the traffic, and the autopilot still lands in every weather preset.
xz: 維修區而家整成一組完整嘅建築，喺機場西北邊、客運大樓後面，一路伸向貨運嗰邊，就係啟德圖表同運動公園地圖標示嘅位置。 機庫 維修停機坪後面有三個機庫：最近客運大樓嘅係細嗰個，旁邊係一個大嘅淺色機庫，天台有天窗條紋同兩個亮燈機庫門，仲有一個深色機庫，兩個亮燈機庫門，天台係一格格天窗。頭兩個機庫中間有座有肋紋、窗仔亮燈嘅工場塔，每個機庫都有箭嘴招牌（係自創嘅，唔係真公司商標）。有兩架飛機機頭伸出機庫門。 由停機坪嗰邊望維修區。 機庫前面嘅停機坪 圍欄入面有一架拆咗嘅 747，周圍有黃色工作架同裝載車 最後一個客運機位後面有紅白相間嘅擋噴氣牆 低矮嘅轉機大樓，天台有設備同上落貨披檐 維修停機坪一枝枝泛光燈柱 客運大樓主樓後面有油缸區 有圍欄嘅飛機維修區，前面係擋噴氣牆同停車場。 夜晚 機庫門透出暖黃色光，工場窗仔亮燈，泛光燈同機場其他燈一齊著。 夜晚亮燈嘅機庫門。 所有新建築對交通嚟講都係實心嘅，自動駕駛喺每種天氣下仍然可以降落。
a: Three hangars with skylight roofs and open door bays beyond a fenced compound with a stripped 747.
az: 有圍欄嘅拆機區後面，三個有天窗天台同開咗門嘅機庫。

t: Remote stands and apron buses
tz: 遠端機位同機場巴士
d: Remote stands 11 to 19 at Kai Tak hold parked aircraft, and apron buses run from a new bus gate to their doors when no jet bridge is free.
dz: 啟德 11 至 19 號遠端機位停咗飛機，冇登機橋可用嗰陣，機場巴士會由新嘅巴士閘口駛去機門。
k: remote stands apron bus bus gate jet bridge ground vehicles Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Kai Tak had more aircraft than jet bridges. Remote stands 11 to 19 on apron lane D2 now hold parked aircraft, and apron buses carry the passengers between them and the terminal. What is new Five aircraft park nose-in on remote stands with no jet bridge, tail toward lane D2. The stop bars on the stands are repainted to match. A bus gate at the root of the pier, with a canopy over the loading lane and a bilingual sign. Five apron buses, one per aircraft. Each drives out along the service road, in front of the noses, down beside its aircraft to the forward left door, waits while passengers get off and on, then drives back to the gate. Buses only run when no jet bridge is free. All eight contact stands are taken (six turnarounds and two parked aircraft), so the overflow goes to the remote stands. Aircraft parked on the remote stands along lane D2. A bus waits at the forward left door. The bus gate beside the pier. What did not change The buses run on the sim clock, so rewind and fast-forward still work. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 啟德嘅飛機比登機橋多。apron 滑行道 D2 旁邊嘅 11 至 19 號遠端機位而家停咗飛機，機場巴士負責喺佢哋同客運大樓之間接載乘客。 有咩新嘢 五架飛機機頭向內停喺冇登機橋嘅遠端機位，機尾對住 D2 滑行道。機位上面嘅停止線都重新畫過。 候機樓突出部分嘅根部加咗巴士閘口，有上蓋同中英文招牌。 五部機場巴士，每架飛機一部。巴士沿服務道路出去，經過機頭前面，再駛到飛機旁邊嘅左前門，等乘客落機同上機，然後返回閘口。 只有冇登機橋可用嗰陣先會行巴士。八個近機位（六個周轉航班加兩架停泊飛機）全部佔用，多出嚟嘅飛機就用遠端機位。 D2 滑行道旁邊遠端機位上嘅飛機。 巴士喺左前門等候。 候機樓突出部分旁邊嘅巴士閘口。 有咩冇變 巴士跟模擬時鐘行，所以倒帶同快進照樣正常。 自動駕駛照樣可以喺所有天氣預設落地，完全唔操作飛機依然會墜毀。
a: Aircraft parked nose-in on the remote stands along apron lane D2.
az: 飛機機頭向內停喺 D2 滑行道旁邊嘅遠端機位。

t: Cargo terminal and freighters
tz: 貨運大樓同貨機
d: Kai Tak gets a cargo terminal with stands 41 to 46, 747-400F and A300-600F freighters in the schedule, cargo loaders and trucks, plus new hangars and car park detail.
dz: 啟德加入貨運大樓同 41 至 46 號機位、時間表有 747-400F 同 A300-600F 貨機、貨運裝載車同貨車，仲有新機庫同停車場細節。
k: cargo terminal freighter 747-400F A300-600F maintenance hangars ground vehicles Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Kai Tak now has a cargo terminal and freighters, working alongside the passenger flights. The cargo apron The cargo terminal stands at the north-east end of the apron, as on the 1996 chart: maroon walls, white end towers, and stacked containers on the roof. Stands 41 to 46 lie on the far side of the lane, with each freighter nose-in to a roller door. Stands 41 to 46 along the cargo terminal. Freighters in the schedule A 747-400F and an A300-600F join the traffic, in two cargo airlines' colours. Two of the eight runway slots in each cycle are now cargo flights: they land, taxi to a cargo stand, are unloaded, and later push back and depart. The flight board shows them as Loading. Cargo handling vehicles At each cargo stand a main-deck loader docks at the side door, and a tug brings a train of container dollies. A forklift shuttles pallets along the terminal's airside docks, and container trucks work the landside docks. They run on the sim clock, like the other ground vehicles. Maintenance hangars and car park The maintenance hangars are in the far north-west corner behind the passenger terminal, with open door bays and skylight strips, and aircraft in for maintenance on the apron in front. The car park roof now has parked cars in its bays and a bigger crowd of spotters. The maintenance hangars, with the car park on the left. Cars in the bays on the car park roof.
xz: 啟德而家有貨運大樓同貨機，同客運航班一齊運作。 貨運停機坪 貨運大樓喺停機坪東北端，同 1996 年圖表一樣：棗紅色外牆、白色端塔，天台疊住貨櫃。41 至 46 號機位喺通道對面，每架貨機機頭向住捲閘門。 貨運大樓旁邊嘅 41 至 46 號機位。 貨機加入時間表 747-400F 同 A300-600F 加入交通，塗上兩間貨運公司嘅顏色。每個週期八個跑道時段之中，有兩個係貨運航班：降落、滑行去貨運機位、卸貨，之後推出同起飛。航班資訊板會顯示「裝貨中」。 貨運地勤車輛 每個貨運機位都有主貨艙裝載車對住側門，仲有拖車拖住一列貨櫃平板車。叉車喺大樓空側碼頭之間運送貨板，貨櫃車就喺陸側碼頭工作。佢哋同其他地勤車輛一樣跟模擬時鐘行。 維修機庫同停車場 維修機庫喺客運大樓後面嘅西北角，有打開嘅機庫門同天窗，前面停機坪有維修中嘅飛機。停車場天台而家車位入面有泊好嘅車，觀景人群都多咗。 維修機庫，左邊係停車場。 停車場天台車位入面嘅車。
a: Six freighters nose-in to the maroon cargo terminal, stands 41 to 46.
az: 六架貨機機頭向住棗紅色貨運大樓，41 至 46 號機位。

t: Real Housing Authority estates
tz: 真實房屋署屋邨
d: Public housing estates now use the Housing Authority's estate list: the 101 estates from 1998 inside the map, each rebuilt from its real block types and heights.
dz: 公共屋邨而家用房屋署嘅屋邨清單：地圖內 101 個 1998 年已入伙嘅屋邨，各按真實大廈類型同高度重建。
k: public housing Housing Authority housing estates Wang Tau Hom Wong Tai Sin Hong Kong Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The public housing estates now come from the Housing Authority's own estate list, not from a guess at which blocks look alike. Real estates, real block types The list gives each estate's location, number of blocks, year of intake and block types. The sim keeps the 145 estates that were in service by 1998, and 101 of them fall inside the map. For each one, the nearest footprints become its blocks, built as the types on the list: Harmony and Cruciform (cross plan), Trident (Y plan), Twin Tower (one tower taller), H blocks, and Old Slab, Slab and Small Household blocks. Floors follow the block type, from about 13 to 21 for Old Slab and Small Household blocks up to 33 to 35 for Trident and 32 to 40 for Harmony. Heights are still kept under the approach clearance. Estates that opened after 1998 are left out. Wang Tau Hom Estate: cross-plan towers in two pastel shades, each with a roof machine room and water tank. One estate, one look Each estate has its own pastel scheme, with a few blocks in a second shade, so neighbouring estates read as different places. Lower Wong Tai Sin Estate, in yellow. Kwai Fong after dark, with lit windows and red obstruction lights. Data Estate list: Housing Authority via DATA.GOV.HK, hosted by Esri China (Hong Kong) Ltd. Rebuild it with python3 tools/estates.py .
xz: 公共屋邨而家用房屋署自己嘅屋邨清單來建，唔再靠估邊啲大廈望落差唔多。 真實屋邨，真實大廈類型 清單列出每個屋邨嘅位置、座數、入伙年份同大廈類型。模擬器保留 1998 年已入伙嘅 145 個屋邨，其中 101 個喺地圖範圍內。每個屋邨會用最近嘅建築物輪廓做佢嘅大廈，按清單上嘅類型來起：和諧式同十字型（十字形平面）、三叉型（Y 形平面）、雙塔式（一高一矮）、H 型，同舊長條型、長條型、小型家庭大廈。 層數跟大廈類型走：舊長條型同小型家庭大廈約 13 至 21 層，三叉型 33 至 35 層，和諧式 32 至 40 層。高度仍然受進場航道淨空限制。1998 年之後先入伙嘅屋邨就唔會出現。 橫頭磡邨：兩種粉彩色嘅十字形大廈，天台都有機房同水缸。 一個屋邨，一個樣 每個屋邨有自己嘅粉彩色，有幾幢用第二種色調，所以相鄰嘅屋邨一眼就睇得出唔同。 黃大仙下邨，黃色嘅一群。 入夜之後嘅葵芳，窗口亮燈，天台有紅色障礙燈。 資料來源 屋邨清單：房屋署經 DATA.GOV.HK 提供，由 Esri China (Hong Kong) Ltd. 託管。用 python3 tools/estates.py 可以重新建立。
a: Wang Tau Hom Estate: cross-plan towers in blue and orange standing together on the hillside, with lift motor rooms and water tanks on the roofs.
az: 橫頭磡邨：藍色同橙色嘅十字形大廈企喺山坡，天台有機房同水缸。

t: Public housing estates in bunches
tz: 公共屋邨成群出現
d: Hong Kong public housing blocks (Harmony, Trident, Twin Tower and slab) now stand in matching estates in the sim, with pastel facades, air-conditioners and roof tanks.
dz: 模擬器入面嘅公共屋邨大廈（和諧式、三叉型、雙塔式同長條型）而家成組出現，有粉彩外牆、冷氣機同天台水缸。
k: public housing housing estates Harmony block Trident block Hong Kong Kai Tak flight simulator
x: Hong Kong's public housing came in a handful of standard blocks, built in bunches to one design. The sim now builds its estates the same way. Blocks that match The map's building footprints are not tagged, so the sim looks for groups of four or more similar, mid-sized tall footprints standing within 75 m of each other. Each group becomes an estate. The central business districts, Mong Kok, Tsim Sha Tsui and Kowloon City keep their tenements, so the street scene under the approach is unchanged. Harmony and Cruciform: a cross plan, the most common shape in the 1990s. Trident: a Y plan with three wings. Twin Tower: two square towers, one taller than the other, in the older estates. Slab and Linear: long, narrow blocks on the tighter sites. A bunch of cross-plan blocks, each with a lift motor room and a water tank on the roof. One estate, one look Every block in an estate shares a height class (roughly 16 to 22 floors in the older estates, 28 to 35 for Trident and Cruciform, 34 to 41 for Harmony) and a pastel scheme, with a few blocks in a second shade. Heights still stay under the approach clearance, so the autopilot lands in every weather preset as before. The facade has a window on every bay, an air-conditioner under many of them, a stair and lift core every eight bays and alternating panels. At night the windows light up in warm and cool white, and the stair cores glow a steady green-white. An estate seen from above: one height class, one pastel scheme, a few blocks in a second shade. The same kind of estate after dark, with lit windows and red obstruction lights. Try this Fly the Runway 31 approach or switch to Spectator , then look at the hillsides of Kwun Tong, Wong Tai Sin and Kwai Chung for the bunches of matching blocks.
xz: 香港嘅公共屋邨用少數幾款標準大廈，成群按同一款設計興建。模擬器而家用同樣方法起屋邨。 成群一式一樣嘅大廈 地圖上嘅建築物輪廓冇標籤，所以模擬器會搵出四幢或以上、大細相若、相距 75 米內嘅高樓輪廓，每一組就變成一個屋邨。中環等商業區、旺角、尖沙咀同九龍城繼續保留舊式唐樓，所以進場航道下面嘅街景冇變。 和諧式同十字型： 十字形平面，係九十年代最常見嘅款式。 三叉型（Trident）： Y 形平面，有三個翼。 雙塔式（Twin Tower）： 兩座方形大廈，一高一矮，見於較舊嘅屋邨。 長條型同橫向型： 喺較窄嘅地盤用，又長又窄。 一群十字形大廈，每幢天台都有升降機機房同水缸。 一個屋邨，一個樣 同一個屋邨嘅大廈高度級別一樣（較舊屋邨約 16 至 22 層，三叉型同十字型約 28 至 35 層，和諧式約 34 至 41 層），顏色都係同一套粉彩色，有少數幾幢用第二種色調。高度仍然受進場航道淨空限制，所以自動導航喺所有天氣下都照樣著陸。 外牆每個窗位都有窗，好多窗下面有冷氣機，每八個窗位有一條樓梯同升降機核心，仲有交替嘅牆板。夜晚窗口會亮起暖白同冷白燈，樓梯核心就發出穩定嘅綠白光。 由上面睇一個屋邨：同一個高度級別、同一套粉彩色，有幾幢用第二種色調。 同類屋邨入夜之後，窗口亮燈，天台有紅色障礙燈。 試吓 飛 Runway 31 進場，或者轉去 Spectator ，然後睇吓觀塘、黃大仙同葵涌嘅山坡，搵一群群一式一樣嘅大廈。
a: A bunch of tall cross-shaped housing blocks with lift motor rooms and water tanks on their roofs, on a hillside above the harbour.
az: 一群十字形高層屋邨大廈，天台有升降機機房同水缸，喺維港上面嘅山坡。

t: Share buttons on the home screen
tz: 主畫面加咗分享掣
d: The home screen now has share buttons for X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads, email, copy link and the system share sheet, in English or Cantonese.
dz: 主畫面而家有分享掣：X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp、Threads、電郵、複製連結同系統分享選單，支援英文同廣東話。
k: share buttons home screen social sharing Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The home screen now has share buttons, so you can send Fly Kai Tak to a friend without leaving the menu. Share from the home screen Under the demo reel there is a new Share Fly Kai Tak row: X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads, Email and Copy link. Each one opens with a short line about the game and a link to flykaitak.com. On phones and browsers that support it, a Share… button opens the system share sheet too. The share row under the demo reel, next to the coffee button. The text and the button labels follow the EN / 粵 button, so the message goes out in English or Cantonese. Each link carries a different utm_source , so shares are counted by network. Try this Open the home screen, press Copy link and paste it into a chat. After a flight, the report card has its own share buttons too.
