t: More detail on the car park roof
tz: 停車場天台加咗好多細節
d: The Plane Spotter car park roof now has globe lamps, a pipe railing and crowd barrier, a painted deck and a stairwell entry with exit and caution signs.
dz: 「飛機觀察」嘅停車場天台而家有圓球燈、鋼管扶手同人群欄障、畫好線嘅地面，仲有掛住出口同小心牌嘅樓梯間入口。
k: car park roof plane spotter globe lamps railing stairwell Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The Kai Tak car park roof was the spotters' favourite spot, and in the Plane Spotter view it now looks like the photos: white globe lamps on black posts, a pipe railing along the parapet, and a stairwell head with its signs. Globe lamps Lamp standards stand in rows across the deck: two staggered rows on the runway side (the nearer one about 7 m in from the parapet) and one along the far edge. Each is a black post with a white globe, and the globes light up at night. The roof after dark: the globe lamps glow, the railing runs along the parapet and a yellow line marks the spotters' edge. Parapet and railing The roof now has a proper parapet wall about 0.7 m high with a pipe rail and a mid rail on posts above it. A grey crowd barrier stands 2.2 m inside it on the runway side, with a yellow line painted on the deck beside it. The deck also has parking bays on the far side and lane dashes down the middle. Stairwell entry and signs At the end of the roof there is a white stairwell block with a flat slab roof, a steel door, a green exit sign above it and a yellow caution board beside it, with a wall light that comes on at night. The stairwell head at the runway-side corner of the roof, seen from across the deck. Try this Choose Plane Spotter: car park roof in the view menu, or press C until it comes up, then look around with the mouse or your finger.
xz: 啟德停車場天台一直係飛機迷最愛嘅位置，喺「飛機觀察」視角入面，而家睇落同相片更似：黑色燈柱頂住白色圓球燈，欄河邊有鋼管扶手，仲有樓梯間同埋啲標誌牌。 圓球燈 天台上面一行行咁企住燈柱：跑道嗰邊有兩行錯開咗，近嗰行距離欄河大約 7 米，另外遠邊緣仲有一行。每支都係黑色燈柱加白色圓球，夜晚球會亮。 天黑之後嘅天台：圓球燈亮晒，扶手沿住欄河伸延，黃線標示飛機迷企嘅位置。 欄河同扶手 天台而家有條真正嘅欄河牆，大約 0.7 米高，上面有鋼管扶手同中間橫桿。跑道嗰邊向內 2.2 米位置企住一排灰色人群欄障，旁邊地面畫咗條黃線。地面遠邊仲有停車位，中間有車道虛線。 樓梯間入口同標誌 天台一端有個白色樓梯間，平頂、鋼門，門上面有綠色出口牌，旁邊有塊黃色小心牌，夜晚仲有盞牆燈會亮。 跑道嗰邊天台轉角嘅樓梯間，由天台對面望過去。 試吓 喺視角選單揀 Plane Spotter: car park roof ，或者㩒 C 直至轉到呢個視角，然後用滑鼠或者手指四圍望。
a: The car park roof at night with glowing white globe lamps and a pipe railing along the parapet.
az: 夜晚嘅停車場天台，發光嘅白色圓球燈同欄河上嘅鋼管扶手。

t: FAA signs and markings on the airfield
tz: 機場加咗 FAA 標誌同標記
d: Fly Kai Tak now has FAA-style airfield signs and markings: touchdown-zone bars, hold lines, link taxiways B1 to B6, and mandatory, location, direction and distance signs.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有 FAA 款機場標誌同標記：接地區標記、等候線、B1 至 B6 連接滑行道，仲有強制、位置、方向同距離標誌牌。
k: signs markings FAA AIM taxiway runway hold short touchdown zone Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The airfield now carries the standard signs and markings from the FAA Aeronautical Information Manual (chapter 2, section 3): runway markings, yellow taxiway markings, and five of the manual's six families of airport sign (the information sign is not in yet). The colours follow the manual, so a red sign always means a runway, and a yellow one always means a taxiway. 5 Sign types mandatory, location, direction, destination, distance 10 Distance signs per landing direction 3,000 ft Touchdown-zone bars from each threshold Runway markings Each threshold keeps its bars and number. The touchdown-zone bars now run on past the aiming point, as three pairs, the aiming point, then two pairs, two pairs and single pairs out to 3,000 ft. The centre line is now cut into 120 ft stripes with 80 ft gaps. Runway 13: threshold bars, the aiming point and the touchdown-zone bars along the centre line. Holding positions and taxiway markings The six link taxiways between the runway and taxiway A are named B1 to B6, counting from the 13 end. Each one has a yellow centre line, with extra dashes beside it for the last stretch before the runway holding position. The holding position is four lines: two solid lines on the taxiway side where you stop, and two dashed lines on the runway side. Taxiway A also has a double yellow edge line along its runway side, broken where each link joins it. B1 at the runway: red 13-31 holding signs, the B1 direction sign and the four-line holding position. Signs Mandatory (white on red): 13-31 at each link's holding position, and 13 and 31 at the two ends of taxiway A. Location (yellow on black): B1 to B6 beside the holding signs, and A at the runway ends. Direction (black on yellow): on taxiway A, each link has a sign with its name and an arrow, one for each direction of travel. Destination (black on yellow): where the apron lanes leave taxiway A. D3 points to stands 1-8, D2 to remote stands 11-19, and D1 to the apron. Distance remaining (white on black): a numeral for the thousands of feet left, every 1,000 ft down the left side for each landing direction. The B1 link by day, from beside the runway. The signs are lit from inside, so they stay readable at night, and the painted lines dim with the rest of the ground. The same view at night. The B1 to B6 names and the apron destination numbers are the sim's own, not from the Kai Tak chart. Taxiway A's yellow centre line was also drawing white after the night dimming code ran; it is yellow again. Landings are unaffected: the autopilot still lands on both runways in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 機場而家有齊 FAA《航空資訊手冊》（第 2 章第 3 節）嘅標準標誌同標記：跑道標記、黃色滑行道標記，仲有手冊六類機場標誌牌入面嘅五類（資訊牌未有）。顏色跟手冊：紅色牌永遠係指跑道，黃色牌永遠係指滑行道。 5 標誌牌類型 強制、位置、方向、目的地、距離 10 距離牌 每個降落方向 3,000 ft 接地區標記 由每個跑道頭計起 跑道標記 每個跑道頭都保留條紋同號碼。接地區標記而家喺瞄準點之後繼續延伸：三對、瞄準點、兩對、兩對，之後係單對，一直去到 3,000 呎。中線改為 120 呎長嘅線段同 80 呎空隙。 13 號跑道：跑道頭條紋、瞄準點同沿中線嘅接地區標記。 等候位置同滑行道標記 跑道同 A 滑行道之間嘅六條連接滑行道，由 13 端數起叫 B1 至 B6。每條都有黃色中線，入跑道等候位置前最後一段，中線旁邊加咗短線。等候位置係四條線：滑行道一邊係兩條實線，要喺呢度停；跑道一邊係兩條虛線。A 滑行道靠跑道嗰邊亦有雙黃邊線，每條連接滑行道接入處斷開。 B1 接跑道處：紅色 13-31 等候牌、B1 方向牌同四線等候位置。 標誌牌 強制（紅底白字）： 每條連接滑行道嘅等候位置有 13-31，A 滑行道兩端有 13 同 31。 位置（黑底黃字）： 等候牌旁邊有 B1 至 B6，跑道盡頭有 A。 方向（黃底黑字）： A 滑行道上，每條連接滑行道都有寫住名同箭咀嘅牌，兩個行駛方向各一塊。 目的地（黃底黑字）： 停機坪滑行道離開 A 滑行道嘅位置。D3 指向 1-8 號機位，D2 指向 11-19 號遠端機位，D1 指向停機坪。 剩餘距離（黑底白字）： 顯示剩低幾千呎嘅數字，每個降落方向沿左邊每 1,000 呎一塊。 日間嘅 B1 連接滑行道，由跑道邊望過去。 標誌牌係內部照明，夜晚都睇得清；地面嘅漆線就同其他地面一樣變暗。 同一個角度嘅夜景。 B1 至 B6 嘅名同停機坪目的地號碼係模擬器自己用嘅，唔係啟德機場圖上嘅。A 滑行道嘅黃色中線之前喺夜間變暗處理後會變白色，而家已經回復黃色。降落冇受影響：自動駕駛仍然可以喺所有天氣預設下降落兩條跑道，而完全唔操作飛機仍然會墜毀。
a: Link taxiway B1 meeting the runway, with a red 13-31 holding sign, a yellow B1 direction sign and yellow lines across the taxiway.
az: B1 連接滑行道接駁跑道：紅色 13-31 等候牌、黃色 B1 方向牌，同橫過滑行道嘅黃線。

t: Fix: Aircraft Stay on the Tarmac
tz: 修正：飛機只喺柏油路面行駛
d: Fly Kai Tak ground fix: arrivals leave the runway by a link taxiway, every aircraft keeps its wheels on the tarmac, and the grass is off limits.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 地面修正：降落飛機經連接滑行道離開跑道，所有飛機嘅機輪都喺柏油路面上，草地唔准行。
k: Kai Tak taxiway tarmac grass taxiing link taxiway runway excursion
x: Aircraft on the ground now stay on the grey tarmac. None of them drives across the green grass any more. What is new Arrivals used to leave the runway on a straight diagonal across the grass to taxiway A. They now turn off onto a link taxiway, follow it to taxiway A and carry on to the stand. Runway 13 arrivals take the link that leans toward the 31 end, and Runway 31 arrivals take a new link that leans toward the 13 end. There are now six links: five lean toward the 31 end and one toward the 13 end. Round pads widen the tightest corners, where a link meets taxiway A and where taxiway A curves onto each end of the runway. The nose wheel now stays on the tarmac through the turn. Your own aircraft has to keep all three wheels on the tarmac. Leave it at more than about 12 kt and the run ends in a runway excursion. Slower than that, the aircraft stops at the edge and a message tells you why. A touchdown with a wheel beyond the tarmac edge now counts as landing off the runway. A Runway 13 arrival leaves the runway by the link taxiway instead of cutting across the grass. Runway 31 arrivals use a new link that leans the other way. Steered off the side at walking pace, the aircraft stops at the edge of the tarmac. How it was checked The test script now steps through every moment of the other aircraft taxiing, docking and being pushed back, on both runways and in the approach, Free flight and Plane Spotter modes. At every step the nose wheel and both main wheels must be on the tarmac. It also steers your own aircraft off the runway on each side, at walking pace and at speed. What did not change The arrival and departure timings are the same, so every aircraft still docks and departs at the same moment as before. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 喺地面嘅飛機而家只會喺灰色柏油路面上行駛，唔會再駛過綠色草地。 有咩新嘢 降落嘅飛機以前會斜斜地橫過草地，由跑道直接駛去滑行道 A。而家佢哋會轉入連接滑行道，沿住行去滑行道 A，再繼續行去停機位。13 跑道嘅降落飛機用向 31 端傾斜嗰條連接滑行道，31 跑道嘅降落飛機就用新加嘅、向 13 端傾斜嗰條。連接滑行道而家一共有六條：五條向 31 端傾斜，一條向 13 端傾斜。 喺最窄嘅彎位，即連接滑行道同滑行道 A 交界，以及滑行道 A 彎入跑道兩端嗰度，加咗圓形嘅加闊位。轉彎時前輪而家都會留喺柏油路面上。 你自己嘅飛機要三個輪都喺柏油路面上。如果以超過大約 12 kt 嘅速度離開路面，今次飛行會以衝出跑道（Runway excursion）收場；慢過呢個速度，飛機就會停喺路面邊緣，並且彈出訊息話你知原因。 著陸時只要有一個輪喺柏油路面以外，而家就算係降落喺跑道之外。 13 跑道嘅降落飛機經連接滑行道離開跑道，唔再橫過草地。 31 跑道嘅降落飛機用新加嘅、向另一邊傾斜嘅連接滑行道。 以步行速度轉出跑道邊，飛機會停喺柏油路面邊緣。 點樣測試 測試程式而家會逐刻檢查其他飛機滑行、泊位同推後嘅過程，包括兩條跑道，以及進場、自由飛行同觀機三種模式。每一刻前輪同兩邊主輪都一定要喺柏油路面上。測試亦會將你嘅飛機向兩邊轉出跑道，分別試步行速度同高速兩種情況。 冇變嘅嘢 降落同離港嘅時間冇變，所以每架飛機泊位同離開嘅時間同之前一樣。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣預設都仍然可以降落，唔操作嘅話仍然會墜毀。
a: A 747 turning off Runway 13 onto a link taxiway, with taxiway A and the green grass on either side.
az: 一架 747 由 13 跑道轉入連接滑行道，滑行道 A 同綠色草地分別喺兩邊。

t: The map is off until you turn it on
tz: 地圖預設關閉，要開先自己開
d: Fly Kai Tak's corner map now starts hidden on the home screen and in flights. Press M or tick Map with live aircraft under Options to show it.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖而家喺主畫面同飛行入面預設收埋；㩒 M 鍵或者喺「選項」剔選「即時飛機地圖」就會顯示。
k: map home screen M key default options Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The corner map no longer switches itself on when the home screen loads. It starts hidden, and you turn it on when you want it. What changed The map used to be on by default. It is now off until you ask for it, on the home screen and in flights. Press M , or tick Map with live aircraft under Options, to show it. The tick box starts unticked and follows the key, and whatever it says when you press Begin descent is how the flight starts. The home screen on load: no map until you press M. Once on, the map keeps its larger size on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, and moves clear of High scores.
xz: 主畫面載入時，角落地圖唔會再自動開啟。佢預設收埋，要睇先自己開。 改咗啲乜 地圖以前預設係開嘅，而家喺主畫面同飛行入面都預設關閉。㩒 M 鍵，或者喺「選項」剔選「即時飛機地圖」就會顯示。剔選格預設冇剔，會跟住 M 鍵變；你撳「Begin descent」嗰一刻係點，飛行就點開始。 主畫面一載入：㩒 M 之前冇地圖。 開咗之後，地圖喺主畫面同 Plane Spotter 仍然係大尺寸，而且會避開 High scores 面板。

tz: 加長推力桿，微調更準
d: Fly Kai Tak's thrust lever bar is now up to 260 px tall on desktop and 170 px on landscape phones, giving finer control of thrust.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅推力桿而家喺桌面最長 260 px、手機橫向最長 170 px，微調推力更準。
k: thrust throttle touch controls thrust levers slider Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The thrust lever bar on the touch controls is now about twice as long on a desktop-size screen, so each percent of thrust covers more pixels and small adjustments are easier. 260 px Longest bar was 140 px 30% Of screen height scales with the window 1% Thrust steps unchanged What changed The thrust bar used to be a fixed 140 px tall. It now grows with the window, up to 260 px, and stays shorter on small screens so it never covers the altitude tape. On phones in landscape it is up to 170 px, up from 96 px. The thrust still moves in 1% steps and the autopilot still takes over the levers the same way. The longer thrust bar at the bottom right, set at 9%.
xz: 觸控操控嘅推力桿而家喺桌面尺寸螢幕上大約長咗一倍，每 1% 推力佔多啲像素，微調容易好多。 260 px 最長嘅桿 以前係 140 px 30% 螢幕高度 跟視窗大細縮放 1% 推力級距 冇變 改咗啲乜 推力桿以前固定 140 px 高，而家會跟視窗大細變長，最長 260 px；細螢幕上會短啲，唔會遮住高度條。手機橫向由 96 px 加到最長 170 px。推力仍然以 1% 為單位移動，自動駕駛接管推力桿嘅方式都冇變。 右下角加長咗嘅推力桿，設定喺 9%。
a: The 747 on approach with the longer thrust bar at the bottom right, set at 9 percent.
az: 747 進場，右下角嘅推力桿加長咗，設定喺 9%。

t: A bigger map on the home screen and in Plane Spotter
tz: 主畫面同 Plane Spotter 嘅大啲地圖
d: Fly Kai Tak's corner map is now double size on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, and the home screen map moves clear of the High scores panel.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖喺主畫面同 Plane Spotter 而家大兩倍，主畫面嘅地圖會避開 High scores 面板。
k: map home screen Plane Spotter high scores live aircraft M key Kai Tak flight simulator
x: The corner map is now twice the size on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, and on the home screen it moves out of the way when you open High scores. 2× Bigger map home screen and Plane Spotter Spotter Map is back M or the Map button Scores Map steps aside never under the panel What changed On the home screen the map is drawn at twice its flight size, so the demo flight and the traffic around Kai Tak are easy to read. It sits top left. When you open High scores the map moves to the nearest clear spot, such as the bottom right beside the options, and returns when you close the panel. Plane Spotter now shows the map too, at the same larger size. t: Concorde at Kai Tak: The Rare Visits
tz: 協和式客機喺啟德：罕見訪問
d: Concorde's rare visits to Kai Tak: the 1976 sales tour, a 1985 charter, and how Fly Kai Tak's Concorde special lands, taxis and takes off.
dz: 協和式客機罕見到訪啟德：1976 年推廣旅程、1985 年包機，以及 Fly Kai Tak 協和式特別訪客點降落、滑行同起飛。
k: Kai Tak Concorde 1976 1985 supersonic history plane spotter
x: Concorde never flew a scheduled service to Hong Kong. Its visits to Kai Tak were one-off events, and each one drew a crowd. Here is what is on record, and how the Concorde special in Fly Kai Tak echoes it. November 1976: the first visit The first Concorde to land at Kai Tak arrived on 5 November 1976, a day early, as part of a 31,000-mile sales tour of the Far East. It flew in from Manila in 51 minutes and stayed two days. Thousands of people gathered at the terminal building to see it. March 1985: a charter from Bangkok On 3 March 1985 another Concorde landed at 11:17 a.m., two hours out of Bangkok. It was a charter flying passengers to join an ocean liner on a round-the-world voyage. Residents remembered the departure for its noise: ear-splitting, with window frames rattling in nearby homes. Landing at Kai Tak Like every jet, it had to fly the IGS 13 approach: down over Kowloon, a hard right turn at the checkerboard, and a short final onto Runway 13. A delta wing lands nose-high and fast, and the pilots lowered the drooping nose to see the runway. The Concorde model landing nose-high over Kowloon City, gear down. On the ground On the apron the Concorde was a long, low shape among the wide-bodies. In the sim it taxis to stand 6 with its nose drooped, and a tug pushes it back for departure. Taxiing to stand 6 beside a wide-body on the apron. Take-off Take-off was the loud part. The Concorde model rolls down Runway 13 on all four engines, lifts its nose and climbs steeply over Kowloon Bay. The take-off roll on Runway 13. Climbing steeply over Kowloon Bay. In Fly Kai Tak Because these visits were so rare, the Concorde is a special in Plane Spotter: once an hour it lands, parks at stand 6 and departs. The airline on the board is made up. Choose Spotter · Concorde special on the home screen to have it arrive at once. See A Concorde Visits Kai Tak for how it works. Sources When Concorde first landed in Hong Kong, in November 1976 (South China Morning Post) and 1985 - Concorde arriving at Kai Tak (Gwulo).

x: Plane spotters never forgot the days a Concorde came to Kai Tak. It was a rare visit, so in Plane Spotter it is a special: a supersonic delta-wing jet that lands, parks and leaves again. The visit Once an hour the special arrives on the active runway, taxis to stand 6 and, about ten minutes later, pushes back and departs. The usual turnaround at that stand skips that slot so nothing is in the way. A toast tells you when it is on approach. On final over Kowloon, nose drooped. The shape The model has a slender fuselage, a long ogival delta wing with elevons, four engines in long pods under it and a tall fin. The nose droops for landing and taxi and rises for flight. It lands nose-high and fast, and it climbs steeply after take-off. The drooped nose. Parked at stand 6. On the board The flight information board shows its arrival and departure as special rows with a gold outline. The airline is made up: no real names or liveries. t: New: a landing lesson for first-time pilots
tz: 新增：俾初學者嘅降落教學
d: Fly Kai Tak now has a Landing lesson: a coach panel walks first-time pilots through the Runway 13 IGS approach in nine steps with live meters and plain-language tips.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 新增降落教學：教練面板分九步帶初學者飛 13 號跑道嘅 IGS 進場，有實時量表同淺白提示。
k: Kai Tak landing lesson tutorial beginner IGS 13 flight simulator onboarding
x: Taken off, and now want to land? Fly Kai Tak has a new Landing lesson. It uses the same coach panel as the Take-off lesson, but on the real IGS 13 approach: nine steps from wheels down to the stop, with a live meter for each one and the control to use pulsing on screen. No experience needed. 9 Steps wheels down to the stop 3,100 ft Start height on the IGS, heading 088 47° Right turn over the checkerboard Pick it on the start screen Choose Landing lesson under Mode, pick any aircraft and weather, and press Start the lesson. You start on the approach to Runway 13 with the magenta guide hoops on and the autopilot off. If you get lost, press Z and the autopilot flies the rest of the approach. Landing lesson sits next to Take-off lesson under Mode. Nine steps Welcome. The six moves of a landing in plain words. Wheels down. Press G . Landing flaps. Press F twice, to the landing setting. Hold your approach speed. Gear and flaps add drag, so the jet slows by itself. Use the thrust ( E and Q ) to settle about 10 kt above your Vref. Follow the hoops. Steer with ← → and stay on the glidepath with ↑ ↓ . A meter shows how far you are left or right of the line. Turn right. Over the checkerboard, follow the curve of the hoops through about 47° until the runway is dead ahead. Final. Hold the glidepath and speed down to 50 ft above the runway. Flare. A short pull back and thrust to idle. The meter shows the descent rate against the 300 ft/min target. Brake to a stop. Keep the thrust at idle and stay on the centre line. Step 4: the speed meter marks the zone from Vref to Vref plus 15 kt. Step 6: the turn meter counts down to a runway-aligned heading. The coach watches you If something goes wrong, the panel says so in plain words: Too slow or too fast, and which way to move the thrust. Below or above the glidepath, and which way to move the nose. Off the line to the left or right of the hoops. Bank too steep, or a stall warning. After touchdown, drifting off the centre line or thrust left above idle. Step 8: about 55 ft over Runway 13, with the descent rate meter in view. After the landing The result card grades the landing as usual and adds that the lesson is complete. If you crash, it adds a tip for what went wrong: gear up, hard landing, runway excursion, overrun, stall or flying into the city. Lesson landings are not entered on the high score table, so you can practise freely. The rewind buttons bring the coach back to the right step, and Skip lesson is on screen the whole time. Next The Take-off lesson's last card now links straight to the Landing lesson. After that, the IGS 13 approach is the real thing, with the guide hoops and score.
xz: 起飛學識咗，想學降落？Fly Kai Tak 新增降落教學。佢用同起飛教學一樣嘅教練面板，不過喺真正嘅 IGS 13 進場入面進行：由放起落架到停機一共九步，每一步都有實時量表，要用嘅操控會喺畫面上閃動。唔使有任何經驗。 9 步驟 由放起落架到停機 3,100 呎 起始高度 喺 IGS 上，航向 088 47° 右轉 喺棋盤上空 喺開始畫面揀 喺「模式」揀 降落教學 ，揀一款機同天氣，然後㩒「開始教學」。你會喺 13 號跑道嘅進場路線上開始，洋紅色引導圈已經開咗，自動駕駛就閂咗。如果迷失咗方向，㩒 Z ，自動駕駛會幫你飛完餘下嘅進場。 降落教學喺「模式」入面，緊貼起飛教學。 九個步驟 歡迎。 用淺白嘅說話講降落嘅六個動作。 放起落架。 按 G 。 降落襟翼。 按兩下 F ，放到降落設定。 保持進場速度。 起落架同襟翼會增加阻力，飛機自己會減速。用推力（ E 同 Q ）將速度穩定喺比 Vref 高約 10 節。 跟住引導圈。 用 ← → 轉向，用 ↑ ↓ 保持喺下滑道。量表會顯示你偏左或者偏右幾遠。 右轉。 喺棋盤上空，跟住引導圈嘅弧度轉大約 47°，直至跑道喺正前方。 最後進場。 保持下滑道同速度，一直到跑道上空 50 呎。 拉平。 輕輕拉一下桿，推力收到慢車。量表會顯示下降率同 300 呎／分鐘嘅目標。 煞停。 推力保持慢車，行喺中線上直至停定。 第 4 步：速度量表標出由 Vref 到 Vref 加 15 節嘅範圍。 第 6 步：轉彎量表倒數到同跑道對正嘅航向。 教練會睇住你 有咩問題，面板會用淺白嘅說話提你： 太慢或者太快，同埋推力應該點調。 低過或者高過下滑道，同埋機頭應該點調。 偏左或者偏右離開引導圈。 傾斜太大，或者失速警告。 著陸之後，偏離中線或者推力仲高過慢車。 第 8 步：13 號跑道上空約 55 呎，下降率量表清楚可見。 降落之後 結果畫面會照常評分，另外會加一句教學完成。如果撞機，會加一個提示講邊度出錯：起落架冇放、重著陸、衝出跑道、衝過跑道尾、失速或者撞入市區。教學嘅降落唔會計入高分榜，所以可以放心練習。倒帶掣會將教練帶返去啱嘅步驟，「Skip lesson」全程都喺畫面上。 下一步 起飛教學最後一張卡而家直接連去降落教學。之後，IGS 13 進場就係真正嘅挑戰，有引導圈同分數。
a: The Landing lesson welcome panel above a 747 on the IGS approach to Kai Tak, with a Start the lesson button.
az: 降落教學嘅歡迎面板，下面係一架喺啟德 IGS 進場嘅 747，有「Start the lesson」按鈕。

t: A Map option on the home screen
tz: 主畫面嘅地圖選項
d: Fly Kai Tak's home screen now has a Map with live aircraft option, so you can start a flight with the corner map on or off. M still toggles it in flight.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面而家有「即時飛機地圖」選項，開始飛行時可以揀開或者關角落地圖；飛行途中仍然可以用 M 鍵開關。
k: map home screen options live aircraft M key Kai Tak flight simulator Hong Kong 1998
x: The home screen now has a Map option, so you can choose whether the corner map is on before you start a flight. What changed Under Options, between the approach guide and the Walled City choice, there is a new tick box called Map with live aircraft. It is ticked by default. Untick it and the next flight starts with the map hidden. Tick it to see you and the other traffic on the corner map. In flight, the Map button or M still turns it on and off. The home screen box follows whatever you last chose, so when you go back to the menu it shows the current setting. The new tick box in the home screen Options, with a Cantonese label when the language button is set to 粵. The map is not shown in Plane Spotter or the cabin view, whatever this box says.
xz: 主畫面而家有個地圖選項，開始飛行之前就可以揀角落地圖要唔要開。 改咗啲乜 喺「選項」入面，進場導航同九龍寨城選項之間，多咗一個剔選格，叫「即時飛機地圖」，預設係剔咗。取消剔選，下一次飛行就唔會顯示地圖；剔返就會喺角落地圖睇到你同其他飛機。 飛行途中，Map 掣或者 M 鍵照舊可以開關。主畫面個剔選格會跟你最後一次嘅選擇，所以返去選單時會顯示而家嘅設定。 主畫面選項入面新增嘅剔選格；語言掣設為「粵」時會顯示廣東話標籤。 無論呢個格點揀，Plane Spotter 同客艙視角都唔會顯示地圖。
a: The home screen options with the new Map with live aircraft tick box under Computer flies the aircraft.
az: 主畫面選項，「Computer flies the aircraft」下面多咗「Map with live aircraft」剔選格。

t: A map toggle with live aircraft
tz: 可以開關嘅即時飛機地圖
d: Fly Kai Tak's corner map now plots the other aircraft live, amber in the air with altitude and grey on the ground, and a Map button or the M key hides it.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅角落地圖而家即時顯示其他飛機：空中係琥珀色同有高度，地面係灰色；Map 掣或者 M 鍵可以收埋。
k: map live aircraft traffic minimap M key Kai Tak flight simulator Hong Kong 1998
x: The corner map now has a Map button, and it shows the other aircraft as well as yours. Press M or tap Map to show or hide it. Amber Airborne traffic altitude in hundreds of feet Grey On the ground apron, taxiways, runway M Map on / off or the Map button What changed The map used to show only your own aircraft, the IGS track and the runway. It now plots every other airliner in the sim: the 747 ahead of you, the A340 behind, departures climbing out over Kowloon Bay and the aircraft in the holds. Each one is drawn as a small arrow pointing the way it is heading. An aircraft in the air is amber, with its altitude beside it in hundreds of feet. An aircraft on the ground is grey. The count of aircraft on the map is in the bottom right corner. The positions come from the sim's own clock, so they follow rewind, fast-forward and pause exactly like the aircraft you see in the window. On the IGS 13 approach. The map in the top left shows another aircraft in amber, with its altitude. Lined up on Runway 13 in free flight. The map counts the traffic around the airport. Hiding it If you would rather fly by the view out of the window, press M or tap Map to hide the map. Press it again to bring it back. The map is not shown in Plane Spotter or the cabin view, and the Map button is hidden in Plane Spotter. The same approach with the map off. The map is for awareness, not a guide. The magenta line is still the IGS track, and the checkerboard is the orange square.
xz: 角落嘅地圖而家有個 Map 掣，而且除咗你部機，仲會顯示其他飛機。㩒 M 或者撳 Map 就可以顯示或者收埋。 琥珀色 空中嘅飛機 高度以百呎計 灰色 地面嘅飛機 停機坪、滑行道、跑道 M 地圖開 / 關 或者撳 Map 掣 改咗啲乜 以前地圖只係顯示你自己部機、IGS 航線同跑道。而家連場內其他客機都會畫上去：你前面嗰部 747、後面嗰部 A340、喺啟德灣上空爬升嘅離場機，同等候航道入面嘅飛機。每部機都係一個細箭嘴，指住佢飛嘅方向。喺空中嘅係琥珀色，旁邊有高度（以百呎計）；喺地面嘅係灰色。地圖右下角有顯示地圖上飛機嘅數目。 位置係跟模擬器自己嘅時鐘計，所以快退、快進同暫停都會同你窗外見到嘅飛機一模一樣。 IGS 13 進場。左上角嘅地圖用琥珀色顯示另一部飛機同佢嘅高度。 自由飛行，對正 13 號跑道。地圖會數埋機場附近嘅飛機。 收埋佢 如果你想淨係睇窗外嘅景色飛，㩒 M 或者撳 Map 就可以收埋地圖，再㩒一次就會返嚟。Plane Spotter 同客艙視角入面唔會顯示地圖，Plane Spotter 入面連 Map 掣都會收埋。 同一個進場，地圖收埋咗。 地圖係用嚟留意四周，唔係導航。洋紅色線仍然係 IGS 航線，橙色方塊係棋盤。
a: The 747 on the IGS approach over Kowloon, with the corner map showing another aircraft in amber with its altitude.
az: 747 喺九龍上空 IGS 進場，角落地圖用琥珀色顯示另一部飛機同佢嘅高度。

t: The Kai Tak terminal, rebuilt to match the chart
tz: 按啟德機場圖重建嘅客運大樓
d: Fly Kai Tak's terminal and apron now follow the Kai Tak chart: a pier at right angles to the runway, eight nose-in stands, lanes D3, D2 and D1, and new taxi routes.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅客運大樓同停機坪跟返啟德機場圖：同跑道成直角嘅指廊、八個機頭向內停機位、D3、D2、D1 滑行道，同新嘅滑行路線。
k: Kai Tak terminal apron stands jet bridge pushback flight simulator Hong Kong 1998
x: The terminal used to run alongside the runway. On the real airport it did not: the passenger terminal stood at the north-west end of the apron and its pier ran out at right angles to the runway. The sim now follows the airport chart and the terminal plans. 8 Nose-in stands along the pier face 3 Apron lanes D3, D2 and D1 90° Pier to runway as on the chart What moved The pier now sits at the head of the apron with its face toward the runway end, the main terminal block and the multi-storey car park beyond its west end, and two maintenance hangars across the apron. The tower stands on its own base building in the middle of the apron. Stand positions were measured from the chart, so stands 1 to 8 are spaced 63 to 87 m apart rather than evenly. From above: the pier at the north-west end, eight nose-in stands, and apron lanes D3, D2 and D1. Apron lanes and stands Three lanes leave taxiway A at right angles. D3 runs along the stands, and D2 and D1 serve rows of remote stands (numbered 11 to 19). The yellow guidance lines, nose-wheel stop bars and red stand boxes were redrawn for the new layout, with the stand number painted at the lead-in. The pier face, with a jet bridge at each of the eight stands. Traffic follows the new routes Arrivals exit onto taxiway A, turn into lane D3 and then onto the stand's lead-in line. Departures are pushed straight back by the tug, turned a quarter circle toward taxiway A and taxi out from there. Catering trucks, baggage tractors and the pushback tugs run between the wingtips at each stand, and the flight board shows the stand numbers 1 to 6. Stands 7 and 8 always hold a parked aircraft. Plane Spotter: an aircraft at stand 5 being pushed back while the others sit at their bridges. Landings are unaffected: the autopilot still lands on both runways in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 以前個客運大樓係沿住跑道起。真正嘅機場唔係咁：客運大樓喺停機坪西北端，指廊同跑道成直角伸出去。而家模擬器跟返機場圖同大樓平面圖。 8 機頭向內停機位 沿指廊前方 3 停機坪滑行道 D3、D2 同 D1 90° 指廊同跑道 同圖上一樣 改咗啲乜 指廊而家喺停機坪頂端，面向跑道盡頭；主大樓同多層停車場喺指廊西端後面，兩個維修機庫喺停機坪對面。控制塔企喺停機坪中間嘅底座建築上。停機位嘅位置係按圖量度，所以 1 至 8 號機位相隔 63 至 87 米，唔係平均分佈。 俯瞰：西北端嘅指廊、八個機頭向內停機位，同 D3、D2、D1 三條滑行道。 停機坪滑行道同機位 三條滑行道同 A 滑行道成直角。D3 沿住機位，D2 同 D1 服務遠端機位（11 至 19 號）。黃色引導線、前輪停止線同紅色機位框都按新佈局重畫，機位號碼畫喺引入線上。 指廊前方，八個機位各有一條登機橋。 交通跟新路線 到達嘅飛機離開 A 滑行道，轉入 D3，再入機位嘅引入線。離港嘅飛機由拖車直線推後，再轉四分之一圈面向 A 滑行道，然後滑出。飲食車、行李拖車同推機拖車喺每個機位嘅翼尖之間行走，航班資訊板顯示 1 至 6 號機位。7 號同 8 號機位長期停住一架飛機。 機場觀景：5 號機位嘅飛機被推後，其他飛機停喺登機橋旁。 降落冇受影響：自動駕駛仍然可以喺所有天氣預設下降落兩條跑道，而完全唔操作飛機仍然會墜毀。
a: Top-down view of the Kai Tak apron with the terminal pier, eight nose-in stands and three apron lanes.
az: 啟德停機坪俯瞰圖，有客運指廊、八個機頭向內停機位同三條停機坪滑行道。

t: The Flight Board Clatters
tz: 航班資訊板有翻牌聲
d: The Fly Kai Tak flight information board now clatters like a real split-flap board whenever a letter changes, on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, with its own on/off button.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅航班資訊板而家喺字母轉動時會發出翻牌聲，主畫面同觀機模式都有，亦有獨立開關掣。
k: Kai Tak flight information board split-flap sound clack plane spotter
x: The flight information board now clatters. Every time a letter flips on the split-flap board, you hear the old mechanical clack-clack-clack of the flaps turning over. When it plays The sound plays whenever flaps change: a flight moves from Boarding to Pushback, an arrival lands, a new flight takes over a row, or the clock moves on a minute. A few flaps give a few clicks, and a big change gives a long clatter. It plays on the home screen and in Plane Spotter. The board at night from the tower, with the Sound button in its header. Switch it on or off Click the Sound on / Sound off button at the top of the board. The choice is saved in your browser and works on the home screen and in Plane Spotter. The board sound also follows the main Sound button: with Sound off in the sim, the board is silent too. Browsers keep audio locked until you click or press a key, so on the home screen the board starts clacking after your first click. Try this Switch the language with the EN / 粵 button on the home screen. Every letter on the board changes at once, so you get the full clatter.
xz: 航班資訊板而家有聲音喇。每次翻牌板上嘅字母轉，你都會聽到舊式機械翻牌「咔、咔、咔」嘅聲。 幾時會響 只要翻牌轉動就會響：航班由「登機中」變做「推出機位」、抵港航班降落、新航班接手一行，或者時鐘過咗一分鐘。轉幾塊牌就響幾下，大批牌一齊轉就會響成一串。主畫面同觀機模式都有。 夜晚喺塔台睇資訊板，板頭有聲音掣。 開關聲音 㩒資訊板最上面嘅 Sound on / Sound off （廣東話版係「翻牌聲：開／關」）掣就可以。你嘅選擇會儲喺瀏覽器入面，主畫面同觀機模式都通用。資訊板聲音亦會跟住模擬器主要嘅 Sound 掣：模擬器關咗聲，資訊板都會靜晒。 瀏覽器喺你㩒第一下或者撳第一個鍵之前，會鎖住音效，所以主畫面嘅資訊板要等你㩒咗第一下先會響。 試吓 喺主畫面㩒 EN / 粵 掣轉語言，板上每個字母會一齊轉，你就聽到成串翻牌聲。
a: Plane Spotter at night from the tower with the split-flap flight board at the top right.
az: 夜晚喺塔台觀機，右上角有翻牌式航班資訊板。

t: New: Sun, Moon and Time of Day
tz: 新功能：日頭、月亮同時間
d: Fly Kai Tak now has a sun and moon placed for Hong Kong in 1998, a 24-hour clock with Dawn, Day, Dusk and Night presets, and lighting that follows the sun.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有按 1998 年香港位置嘅日頭同月亮、24 小時時鐘（黎明、日間、黃昏、夜間預設），同埋跟住日頭變化嘅光線。
k: Kai Tak time of day sunrise sunset moon
x: Fly Kai Tak now has a real sun and moon. Pick a time of day, or drag the new clock, and the sky, the light and the city follow. 24 h Clock 15-minute steps 4 Presets Dawn, Day, Dusk, Night N Key cycles the presets in flight Where the sun and moon really were The sun and moon are placed for Hong Kong's latitude on an early July day in 1998. The sun rises in the east-north-east, climbs almost overhead at noon and sets in the west-north-west. The moon is a waxing gibbous that rises in the afternoon and sets before dawn, and the stars turn around the pole as the night goes on. Sunrise at 05:30, looking east across Kowloon. Light that follows the sun Sky colour, fog, sunlight and the water all change with the sun's height. Low sun is orange and the sky glows along the horizon, then fades to blue by day. The sea picks up the glitter of the sun by day and of the moon by night, and the clouds turn pink at twilight. On the IGS at dawn (05:15). The city lights are still on under a pink sky. Lights come on at sunset Windows, street lights, neon signs, runway lights and aircraft lights switch on when the sun drops below the horizon, and off again at sunrise. So the Dusk preset is a mix: a glowing sky with the lights already on. The IGS at dusk (18:45). Sunset at 18:15, looking west. The moon has a phase The moon is a disc with a lit side that faces the sun, and a faint glow on its dark side. You can see it by day too, when it is up. The moon at 21:00. Try this On the setup screen choose Dusk , or drag the clock to 18:30. Press N in flight to jump to the next preset.
xz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有真正嘅日頭同月亮。揀一個時間，或者拖動新增嘅時鐘，天空、光線同城市都會跟住變。 24 h 時鐘 每 15 分鐘一格 4 預設 黎明、日間、黃昏、夜間 N 按鍵 飛行途中切換預設 日頭同月亮真正嘅位置 日頭同月亮按香港嘅緯度，擺喺 1998 年 7 月初嘅位置。日頭喺東北偏東升起，中午差唔多喺頭頂，喺西北偏西落山。月亮係盈凸月，下晝升起，喺天亮前落山，而星星會隨夜晚繞住天極轉動。 05:30 日出，向東望過九龍。 光線跟住日頭走 天空顏色、霧、陽光同海面都會隨日頭高度改變。日頭低嗰陣係橙色，地平線發光，日間就淡出變藍。海面日間反射日光，夜晚反射月光，而雲喺黃昏會變粉紅色。 黎明（05:15）沿 IGS 進場。城市嘅燈仲亮住，天空粉紅。 日落就亮燈 日頭落到地平線以下，窗口、街燈、霓虹招牌、跑道燈同飛機燈就會亮起，日出就熄返。所以「黃昏」預設係混合效果：天空仲發光，燈已經開晒。 黃昏（18:45）沿 IGS 進場。 18:15 日落，向西望。 月亮有盈虧 月亮係一個圓盤，向住日頭嗰邊發亮，暗邊有微弱嘅光。月亮喺天上嗰陣，日間都睇得到。 21:00 嘅月亮。 試下 喺設定畫面揀 黃昏 ，或者將時鐘拖到 18:30。飛行途中按 N 跳去下一個預設。
a: The sun low over the hills west of Kowloon with a pale orange sky.
az: 日頭低低掛喺九龍西面嘅山上，天空係淡橙色。

t: The Kai Tak Flight Information Board
tz: 啟德航班資訊板
d: Fly Kai Tak adds a split-flap flight information board with every arrival and departure, on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, in English and Cantonese.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 加入翻牌式航班資訊板，列出每班抵港同離港航班，主畫面同觀機模式都有，支援英文同廣東話。
k: Kai Tak flight information board split-flap Solari plane spotter arrivals departures
x: Kai Tak now has its flight information board: an old split-flap board that lists every arrival and departure. It sits on the home screen and in Plane Spotter, so you can see what is due in, what is on the stand and what has gone. On the home screen The board hangs over the live view behind the menu. It lists the arrivals, including the two jets in the hold and the demo aircraft on the approach (marked in orange), and the departures from the stands. The board on the home screen, over the live approach. In Plane Spotter Pick Plane Spotter or Spotter · Runway 31 and the board appears at the top right. It follows the six turnarounds and the aircraft in the hold. Press B , or the Flights button, to hide or show it. On a phone it starts hidden: open More and tap Flights . The board in Plane Spotter, from the car park roof. What the board shows Time : the arrival time for arrivals and the push back time for departures, on a Hong Kong clock (day starts at 10:20, night at 21:40). Flight : a flight number with a colour square that matches the aircraft's tail. The airlines and numbers are made up, so no real airline appears. From / To : where the flight is coming from or going to. Stand : the stand number from the sim's apron. Status : read from the aircraft itself. Arrivals go from Expected to On approach, Short final, Landed, Taxiing and At stand. Departures go from Boarding to Pushback, Taxiing, Holding, Take-off and Departed. Every letter is its own flap, and a flap flips when its letter changes. Finished flights dim and drop to the bottom of their list. In Cantonese The board follows the EN / 粵 button on the home screen and shows its headings, cities and status in Cantonese. The same board in Cantonese. Try this Start Plane Spotter, watch a flight go from Boarding to Pushback on the board, then switch to the Exterior view and follow it out to the runway.
xz: 啟德而家有咗航班資訊板：一塊舊式翻牌（Solari）板，列出每班抵港同離港航班。佢喺主畫面同觀機模式都有，一眼睇到邊班就到、邊班喺機位、邊班已經走咗。 主畫面 資訊板掛喺選單後面嘅實時畫面上面。上面有抵港航班（包括兩架空中等候嘅飛機，同正喺進場嘅示範飛機，用橙色標示），仲有由機位離港嘅航班。 主畫面上嘅資訊板，背後係實時進場畫面。 觀機模式 揀 Plane Spotter 或者 Spotter · Runway 31 ，資訊板就會喺右上角出現。佢跟住六個機位嘅航班同空中等候嘅飛機。㩒 B 或者「Flights」掣就可以收埋或者打開。喺手機上面預設係收埋嘅：打開「More」再㩒「Flights」。 喺停車場天台觀機時嘅資訊板。 資訊板顯示啲乜 時間 ：抵港航班顯示抵港時間，離港航班顯示推出機位時間，用香港時間（日間由 10:20 開始，夜間由 21:40 開始）。 航班 ：航班編號，加一個同機尾顏色一樣嘅色塊。航空公司同編號都係虛構嘅，所以唔會出現真實航空公司。 來自／前往 ：航班嘅出發地或者目的地。 機位 ：模擬器停機坪嘅機位號碼。 狀態 ：直接由飛機嘅狀態讀出。抵港航班會由「預計抵港」變做「進場中」、「最後進場」、「已降落」、「滑行中」同「已泊位」。離港航班會由「登機中」變做「推出機位」、「滑行中」、「地面等候」、「起飛中」同「已起飛」。 每個字母都係一塊翻牌，字母轉嘅時候牌會翻動。完成咗嘅航班會變暗，並且排到名單最底。 廣東話版 資訊板跟住主畫面嘅 EN / 粵 掣，標題、城市同狀態都會用廣東話顯示。 同一塊資訊板嘅廣東話版。 試吓 開始觀機，睇住一班航班喺板上由「登機中」變做「推出機位」，然後轉去 Exterior 視角，跟住佢滑去跑道。
a: Plane Spotter from the car park roof with a split-flap flight board at the top right.
az: 喺停車場天台觀機，右上角有翻牌式航班資訊板。

t: Zoom With the Mouse Wheel
tz: 用滑鼠滾輪縮放
d: Fly Kai Tak now zooms with the mouse wheel: scroll up to zoom in, scroll down to zoom out, 1× to 16×, one step per notch.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 而家可以用滑鼠滾輪縮放：向上滾放大，向下滾縮小，1× 至 16×，每格一級。
k: Kai Tak zoom mouse wheel controls
x: You can now zoom with the mouse wheel. Scroll up to zoom in, and scroll down to zoom out. Scroll up Zoom in 1× to 16× Scroll down Zoom out back toward 1× I / O Same steps keys still work What changed The wheel used to change the distance of the camera. It now uses the same zoom as the I and O keys and the Zoom menu: 1×, 2×, 4×, 8× and 16×. Each notch of the wheel moves one step, so a fast flick on a trackpad does not jump straight to 16×. 1× zoom, the normal view. The same view at 4×, after two notches up. The Zoom menu and the toast at the top show the current level. Double-click still resets the look direction.
xz: 而家可以用滑鼠滾輪縮放。向上滾就放大，向下滾就縮小。 向上滾 放大 1× 至 16× 向下滾 縮小 返回 1× I / O 同一組級數 鍵盤照用 改咗啲乜 以前滾輪係轉鏡頭距離。而家用返同 I 、 O 鍵同 Zoom 選單一樣嘅縮放：1×、2×、4×、8× 同 16×。滾輪每一格行一級，所以喺觸控板快速一撥都唔會一下跳到 16×。 1× 縮放，正常視野。 同一個視野放大到 4×，向上滾兩格之後。 Zoom 選單同畫面頂部嘅提示會顯示而家嘅倍數。連按兩下仍然會重設視線方向。
a: The 747 on the approach to Kai Tak at 4× zoom.
az: 747 喺 4× 縮放下進場啟德。

t: Fix: Buildings and Vehicles Clear of Aircraft
tz: 修正：建築物同車輛避開飛機
d: Fly Kai Tak apron fix: aircraft no longer overlap the car park, the fire station or service vehicles, which now wait out of sight until their aircraft docks.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 停機坪修正：飛機唔會再同停車場、消防局或地勤車輛重疊，車輛會喺視線以外等到飛機泊定先出現。
k: Kai Tak apron collision car park ground vehicles
x: Aircraft, buildings and service vehicles no longer overlap on the apron. What is new The car park and the fire station stood in the pushback lanes of the first stands. They now sit east of the stands, clear of every wing. Baggage tractors, carts and catering trucks wait out of sight until their aircraft docks. They no longer sit where a departing aircraft is pushed back. The spotters' roof view now looks along the runway from the new car park position. The view from the car park roof, now east of the stands. What did not change Traffic still follows the sim clock, so rewind and fast-forward still work. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 停機坪上嘅飛機、建築物同地勤車輛而家唔會再互相重疊。 有咩新嘢 停車場同消防局原本企喺頭幾個停機位嘅推機路線上。而家搬到停機位東面，避開晒所有機翼。 行李拖車、貨車同餐飲車會喺視線以外等，直至飛機泊定先出現，唔會再企喺離港飛機推後嘅位置。 觀機人士嘅停車場天台視角，而家由新位置沿跑道望出去。 停車場天台嘅視野，而家喺停機位東面。 冇變嘅嘢 交通仍然跟模擬時鐘行，倒帶同快進照用。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣預設都仍然可以降落，唔操作嘅話仍然會墜毀。
a: View from the car park roof along the runway with a jet taxiing on the taxiway.
az: 喺停車場天台沿跑道望出去，一架客機喺滑行道上滑行。

t: Home Screen Shows Your Day, Night and Weather Choices
tz: 主畫面即時顯示日夜同天氣選擇
d: On the Fly Kai Tak home screen, the live view of Kowloon behind the menu now updates straight away when you toggle day or night, weather, clouds and lightning.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 主畫面後面嘅九龍實時畫面，而家會即時跟住你揀嘅日間或夜間、天氣、雲同閃電而改變。
k: Kai Tak home screen day night weather flight simulator
x: The picture behind the home screen now follows your choices. Tap Day or Night , pick a weather preset, or switch Clouds and Lightning on or off, and the live view of Kowloon changes straight away. You see what you are about to fly into before you press Begin descent. Night selected: lit streets, stars and a dark harbour behind the menu. Day with Storm selected: heavy grey cloud over the same view. The demo reel inset beside the title is a recording, so it stays as it is. Only the live view behind the menu changes. Your settings carry through when you start a flight, and the autopilot still lands in every weather preset.
xz: 主畫面後面嘅畫面而家會跟住你嘅選擇即時變。㩒 日間 或 夜間 、揀天氣，或者開關 雲 同 閃電 ，後面嘅九龍實時畫面即刻轉。未㩒 Begin descent 之前，就睇到自己會飛入乜嘢天氣。 揀咗夜間：選單後面係燈火通明嘅街道、星空同漆黑嘅海港。 日間配風暴：同一個畫面被厚厚嘅灰雲蓋住。 標題旁邊嘅示範影片係錄影，所以唔會變，只有選單後面嘅實時畫面會跟住變。你嘅設定會帶入飛行，自動駕駛喺每個天氣預設都仍然可以降落。
a: The Fly Kai Tak home screen by day with Storm selected, showing a grey overcast sky over Kowloon behind the menu.
az: Fly Kai Tak 日間主畫面揀咗風暴，選單後面係九龍上空灰濛濛嘅陰天。

t: New: Aircraft Collisions and Damage
tz: 新功能：飛機碰撞同損毀
d: Fly Kai Tak aircraft now have collision detection: ground traffic avoids each other, and a collision shows broken wings, scorch marks, smoke and fire.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅飛機有碰撞偵測：地面交通會互相避開，相撞就會見到機翼折斷、燒焦痕跡、冒煙同起火。
k: Kai Tak collision aircraft damage ground control flight simulator
x: Aircraft on the ground can no longer pass through each other. Traffic now keeps clear, and if two aircraft do touch, both are damaged. What is new Every aircraft has a true outline: fuselage, wings and tailplanes. Overlaps are checked each frame, on the ground and in the air. Ground control holds a taxiing aircraft back when another one, a parked jet or a stopped wreck is in its way. Arrivals go first, then departures. Gates, lanes and the Runway 31 holding bay were moved so that routes no longer cross. If aircraft do touch, a wing or tailplane can snap off, scorch marks appear, the lights go out and smoke and fire rise from the damage. A wrecked aircraft stays where it stopped. Rewinding the clock repairs it. Hit another aircraft in your own jet and the flight ends with a crash. Two aircraft touch on the apron. Smoke rises from the contact point. The damaged aircraft stays where it stopped, with smoke and fire. What did not change Traffic still follows the sim clock, so rewind and fast-forward still work. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 地面上嘅飛機而家唔會再互相穿過。交通會自動避開，萬一真係撞到，兩架都會受損。 有咩新嘢 每架飛機都有真實輪廓：機身、機翼同尾翼。每格畫面都會檢查有冇重疊，地面同空中都一樣。 當前面有另一架飛機、停泊嘅客機或者撞毀嘅殘骸，地面管制會叫滑行中嘅飛機停低等。抵港優先，其次係離港。 登機口、滑行道同 31 號跑道等候位都搬過，路線唔會再交叉。 萬一相撞，機翼或者尾翼可能折斷，出現燒焦痕跡，燈光熄滅，損毀位置冒煙起火。 撞毀嘅飛機會停喺原地。倒帶就會修好。 你自己架飛機撞到其他飛機，飛行就會以墜毀結束。 兩架飛機喺停機坪相撞，接觸位置冒煙。 受損嘅飛機停喺原地，冒煙起火。 冇變嘅嘢 交通仍然跟模擬時鐘行，倒帶同快進照用。 自動駕駛喺所有天氣預設都仍然可以降落，唔操作嘅話仍然會墜毀。
a: Two airliners overlapping on the apron with black smoke rising from the contact.
az: 兩架客機喺停機坪重疊，接觸位置冒出黑煙。

t: New: jet bridges and pushback tugs at the Kai Tak terminal
tz: 新增：Kai Tak 客運大樓嘅空橋同推機拖車
d: Fly Kai Tak adds jet bridges to the Kai Tak terminal. Aircraft taxi in and dock at them, and pushback tugs push each departure back and turn it toward the runway.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 喺 Kai Tak 客運大樓加咗空橋。飛機滑行入場接駁空橋，推機拖車會將離場飛機推後，再轉到對正跑道。
k: Kai Tak terminal jet bridges pushback tug apron
x: The Kai Tak terminal now has jet bridges. Aircraft taxi in, park nose-first at a bridge, and are pushed back by a tug when they leave. What is new Six stands along the terminal, each with its own jet bridge. The terminal is longer so that every stand reaches it. An arriving aircraft leaves the runway, taxis along the parallel taxiway and turns down the stand's yellow lead-in line to stop at the bridge. The bridge swings out to the forward left door once the aircraft has stopped, and swings back before it leaves. A pushback tug waits in a bay in front of the terminal. It drives to the nose gear, pushes the aircraft straight back, turns it to face the runway, then drives back to its bay. After the push the aircraft taxis out and takes off as before. Catering trucks and baggage tractors work each docked aircraft from the right side. The apron buses are gone, because passengers now use the bridges. Three aircraft at the bridges while a 747 is pushed back from the first stand. The bridge cab meets the forward left door. The tug connects at the nose gear and pushes the 747 back from the bridge. The turn at the end of the pushback points the aircraft toward the runway. A 777 taxiing in along the lead-in line. In Plane Spotter and Free flight Each stand has an arriving aircraft that docks and sits at the bridge. Later an identical aircraft takes its place, waits, and is pushed back to depart, so it reads as a turnaround. The runway order is the same as before. What did not change The traffic runs on the sim clock, so rewind and fast-forward still work. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: Kai Tak 客運大樓而家有空橋。飛機滑行入場，機頭向前泊喺空橋度，離開嗰陣就由拖車推返出嚟。 新增咗啲乜 客運大樓有六個機位，每個機位都有自己嘅空橋。大樓加長咗，等每個機位都接到大樓。 降落嘅飛機離開跑道，沿平行滑行道行，再轉入機位嘅黃色引導線，停喺空橋前面。 飛機停定之後，空橋會伸出去接駁機頭左面嘅前艙門，開出之前再縮返。 推機拖車喺大樓前面嘅停車位等。佢駛去機鼻起落架，將飛機直線推後，再轉到對正跑道，然後駛返停車位。 推完之後，飛機照舊滑行出去起飛。 餐飲車同行李拖車喺右面服務每架泊好嘅飛機。機場巴士冇咗，因為乘客而家行空橋。 三架飛機泊喺空橋，第一個機位有架 747 被推後。 空橋艙口接駁前左艙門。 拖車接駁機鼻起落架，將 747 由空橋推後。 推機尾段嘅轉彎令飛機對正跑道。 777 沿引導線滑行入位。 Plane Spotter 同自由飛行 每個機位都有一架降落嘅飛機入位，泊喺空橋度。之後有一架一樣嘅飛機取代佢，等一陣再被推後起飛，睇落就好似同一架飛機轉場。跑道使用次序同之前一樣。 冇改變嘅嘢 交通跟住模擬時鐘行，所以倒帶同快轉照舊有效。 自動駕駛喺每種天氣預設都照樣降落到，冇操作飛行嘅話都照樣墜毀。
a: Aircraft parked nose-in at the terminal jet bridges, with a 747 being pushed back at the left.
az: 飛機機頭向前泊喺客運大樓空橋度，左邊有一架 747 被推後。

t: Apron taxi lines and numbered stands
tz: 停機坪滑行標線同編號停機位
d: Fly Kai Tak's apron now has yellow taxi lines, numbered stands, red stand boxes and service road lines, and the other aircraft taxi along them.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅停機坪而家有黃色滑行引導線、編號停機位、紅色停機位框同服務道路標線，其他飛機亦跟住標線滑行。
k: Kai Tak apron taxi lines stand numbers taxiway
x: The apron now has painted markings that show where to taxi and where to park, and every stand has a number. What is new Yellow taxi guidance lines run along taxiway A, down the east link and along the dark apron lane. Every corner is drawn with the same curve the taxiing aircraft follow. Stands 1 to 7 are the terminal stands. Aircraft park nose-in toward the terminal, with a yellow lead-in line and a stop bar at the nose wheel. Stands 11 to 15 are drive-through stands on the runway side of the lane. Aircraft come in from the lane and leave straight out to the taxiway. Each stand has a red safety box and a yellow number on a dark plate, turned so a pilot can read it while taxiing in. The service road behind the aircraft has white edge lines and a dashed centre line. Each end of taxiway A has curved lead-on lines to the runway and a holding position of two solid and two dashed yellow lines. The whole apron from above. Stands 1 to 7 face the terminal and stands 11 to 15 sit along the lane. Stand numbers, lead-in lines and red stand boxes along the lane. An arrival follows the yellow line along the east link while another aircraft waits on stand 15. At night the markings are dimmed but still easy to follow. Traffic uses the lines Arriving aircraft vacate the runway, taxi west along taxiway A, take the east link and the lane, and stop on a stand. Departing aircraft leave their stand along its line, join taxiway A and taxi to the runway end. Taxiway A is now paved to both runway ends, and the grass between the apron and the taxiway is paved over. The stand numbers are the sim's own. They are not copied from a chart of the real airport. What did not change The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 停機坪而家有地面標線，指示飛機點樣滑行同泊位，每個停機位都有編號。 有咩新嘢 黃色滑行引導線沿住滑行道 A、東連接道同深色嘅停機坪車道伸展。每個轉彎都畫成滑行中飛機行嘅同一條弧線。 1 至 7 號係客運大樓停機位。飛機機頭朝向大樓泊入，有黃色引入線同機鼻輪停止線。 11 至 15 號係車道靠跑道一邊嘅貫通式停機位。飛機由車道駛入，再直接由停機位駛出滑行道。 每個停機位有紅色安全框，同埋深色底板上嘅黃色編號，方向方便滑行入位嘅機師閱讀。 飛機後面嘅服務道路有白色邊線同虛線中線。 滑行道 A 兩端有彎曲嘅引入跑道線，同由兩條實線、兩條虛線組成嘅等候位置。 由上面望成個停機坪。1 至 7 號朝向大樓，11 至 15 號沿住車道。 沿住車道嘅停機位編號、引入線同紅色停機位框。 一架降落嘅飛機沿住東連接道嘅黃線滑行，另一架喺 15 號停機位等候。 夜晚標線會調暗，但仍然容易跟住行。 交通跟住標線行 降落嘅飛機離開跑道後，沿滑行道 A 向西滑行，經東連接道同車道，停喺停機位。 起飛嘅飛機沿停機位嘅線駛出，接駁滑行道 A，再滑行去跑道盡頭。 滑行道 A 而家鋪到兩個跑道盡頭，停機坪同滑行道之間嘅草地亦已經鋪平。 停機位編號係模擬器自己編嘅，唔係由真實機場嘅圖表抄返嚟。 冇改變嘅地方 自動駕駛仍然喺所有天氣預設下降落，完全唔操作仍然會墜毀。
a: The whole apron from above: seven terminal stands in one row, five drive-through stands in another, and the dark lane between them.
az: 由上面望成個停機坪：一排七個客運大樓停機位、一排五個貫通式停機位，中間係深色車道。

t: Blog categories, search and pages
tz: 網誌分類、搜尋同分頁
d: The Fly Kai Tak blog now has categories, a sort by category view, 20 posts per page and a search box that works in English and Cantonese.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 網誌而家有分類、按分類排序、每頁 20 篇同搜尋框，英文同廣東話都用得。
k: blog categories search pagination Fly Kai Tak
x: The blog now has categories , a sort by category view, pages of 20 posts and a search box . Categories Every post belongs to one category: Aircraft, Flying & Procedures, Scenery & Weather, Controls & Devices, Scores & Sharing, or Site & Language. The category shows on each post card and at the top of each post. Pick a category chip on the blog to see only those posts. Sort by category groups the posts under their category. Sort and pages Choose Newest or By category above the posts. Each page shows 20 posts, with Previous, Next and page numbers underneath. Search Type in the search box to find posts by title, description, keywords, category or the words in the post. Results appear as you type, 20 to a page, and work in English and Cantonese. Searching for “ocean park”.
xz: 網誌而家有 分類 、 按分類排序 、 每頁 20 篇 同 搜尋框 。 分類 每篇文章都屬於一個分類：飛機、飛行同程序、風景同天氣、操控同裝置、分數同分享，或者網站同語言。分類會顯示喺每張文章卡同每篇文章頂部。喺網誌㩒一個分類掣，就只會睇到嗰類文章。 按分類排序會將文章歸入各自嘅分類下面。 排序同分頁 喺文章上面揀 最新 或者 按分類 。每頁顯示 20 篇，下面有上一頁、下一頁同頁碼。 搜尋 喺搜尋框輸入文字，就可以按標題、簡介、關鍵字、分類或者文章內文搵文章。結果會一邊打字一邊更新，每頁 20 篇，英文同廣東話都搵得到。 搜尋「ocean park」。
a: The Fly Kai Tak blog sorted by category, with a heading above each group of posts.
az: 按分類排序嘅 Fly Kai Tak 網誌，每組文章上面有分類標題。

t: Fix: the 747 upper-deck hump now has the right shape
tz: 修正：747 上層艙隆起部分形狀更準確
d: The 747-400 upper-deck hump in Fly Kai Tak was too tall and narrow. It is now lower and wider with a long shallow slope into the roof, like the real 747.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅 747-400 上層艙隆起之前太高太窄，而家改成較低較闊，後面有長而平緩嘅斜坡接返機頂，更似真正 747。
k: Kai Tak 747-400 upper deck aircraft models
x: The upper-deck hump on the 747-400 was too tall and too narrow, so it looked like a tower on the roof. It is now lower and wider, with a long shallow slope back into the roof, which is how the real jet is shaped. About a third Lower hump above the fuselage roof Longer Slope to the rear into the roof line What changed The hump now stands about a third lower above the roof of the main fuselage and is slightly wider in proportion. It rises just behind the nose, stays at full height over the flight deck and the front of the upper deck, then fairs back gradually into the roof. The flight deck glazing and the upper-deck windows follow the new shape. Before: a tall hump that ends abruptly. After: a lower hump with a long, gentle slope toward the tail. The new hump from the front, with the flight deck windows set into it. What did not change Only the look of the 747-400 changed. Its size, weight and handling are the same. Flying with no input still ends in a crash, and the autopilot still lands in every weather preset.
xz: 747-400 嘅上層艙隆起部分之前太高又太窄，望落好似機頂企咗座塔。而家改成較低較闊，後面有一段長而平緩嘅斜坡接返落機頂，同真正 747 嘅形狀更加似。 低咗大約三分一 隆起高度 相對機身頂部 更長 向後斜坡 接返機頂線條 改咗啲乜 隆起部分喺主機身頂部之上低咗大約三分一，按比例亦闊咗少少。佢喺機鼻後面開始升起，喺駕駛艙同上層艙前段保持最高，然後逐漸向後收返入機頂。駕駛艙玻璃同上層艙窗都跟住新形狀。 修改前：隆起部分太高，而且突然結束。 修改後：隆起較低，向機尾方向有一段長而平緩嘅斜坡。 由前面望新嘅隆起部分，駕駛艙窗鑲喺入面。 冇改嘅嘢 只係 747-400 嘅外形變咗，大小、重量同操控都冇變。 完全唔操作仍然會墜毀，自動駕駛仍然可以喺所有天氣設定下降落。
a: Side view of a 747-400 on the runway with a low upper-deck hump sloping gently back into the roof.
az: 747-400 喺跑道上嘅側面圖，上層艙隆起較低，並向後平緩斜落機頂。

t: New: Plane Spotter on Runway 31
tz: 新功能：31 號跑道觀機
d: Fly Kai Tak Plane Spotter now has a Runway 31 mode: arrivals over Lei Yue Mun, departures toward Kowloon City, and a Lei Yue Mun spectator view.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 觀機模式而家有 31 號跑道：抵港航班經鯉魚門進場，離港航班向九龍城起飛，仲有鯉魚門觀機視角。
k: Kai Tak Plane Spotter Runway 31 Lei Yue Mun
x: Plane Spotter now works on Runway 31 too. Watch the easterly traffic from the airport's spectator spots, or from the new Lei Yue Mun view. Pick Spotter · Runway 31 On the setup screen, choose Spotter · Runway 31 next to Plane Spotter. There is no flying: arrivals come in over Lei Yue Mun and land from the east, and departures roll toward Kowloon City and climb out. You can follow a jet, jump between the spectator spots or speed up time. An arrival on the Runway 31 approach, seen from the Lei Yue Mun spot at night. The Lei Yue Mun view Choose Plane Spotter: Lei Yue Mun (Runway 31) from the view menu, or press C to cycle to it. In this view the camera favours the jet nearest you, so it follows the arrivals as they come through the gap. Try this Watch an arrival at night from the Lei Yue Mun view, then fly the same approach yourself with Runway 31 approach.
xz: 觀機模式而家都有 31 號跑道。你可以喺機場嘅觀機位置，或者新增嘅鯉魚門視角，睇東面進場嘅飛機。 揀「觀機 · 31 號跑道」 喺設定畫面，喺觀機隔離揀 觀機 · 31 號跑道 。唔使飛：抵港航班經鯉魚門由東面降落，離港航班向九龍城滑行起飛爬升。你可以跟住一架飛機、轉換觀機位置，或者加快時間。 夜晚喺鯉魚門觀機位置，睇 31 號跑道進場嘅抵港航班。 鯉魚門視角 喺視角選單揀 觀機：鯉魚門（31 號跑道） ，或者按 C 切換。呢個視角嘅鏡頭會優先跟最近你嗰架飛機，所以抵港航班穿過缺口時，鏡頭會跟住佢哋。 試吓 夜晚喺鯉魚門視角睇一班抵港航班，然後自己揀 31 號跑道進場飛一次。
a: Night view from Lei Yue Mun of a 747 on approach to Runway 31 with its landing lights on.
az: 夜晚喺鯉魚門望出去，一架開住降落燈嘅 747 正進場 31 號跑道。

t: New: take off from Runway 31 in free flight
tz: 新功能：自由飛行可以喺 31 號跑道起飛
d: Fly Kai Tak free flight now starts on Runway 31 as well as Runway 13, with Runway 31 radio calls, mirrored airport traffic and a climb out over Kowloon City.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 自由飛行而家除咗 13 號跑道，亦可以由 31 號跑道開始，有 31 號跑道無線電、鏡像機場交通，同飛越九龍城嘅離場。
k: Kai Tak Runway 31 take-off free flight
x: You can now take off from Runway 31 as well as land on it. Free flight has a second starting point at the Kowloon Bay end of the runway, pointing at Kowloon City. 314° Runway heading Runway 31 150 kt Pull back full thrust first Choose Runway 31 take-off On the setup screen, pick Runway 31 take-off next to Free flight. You start lined up on Runway 31, and Tower clears you for take-off on that runway. Push the thrust to full, pull back at about 150 kt and raise the gear. Kowloon City is dead ahead, so climb and turn left. Lined up on Runway 31 at night, with Kowloon ahead. The same airport, mirrored The other aircraft follow Runway 31 too: departures line up and take off to the north-west, arrivals land from the east, and the holding aircraft move to the south-east. Radio calls and chatter use Runway 31 as well. Landings in free flight are still graded, and you can carry on with a touch-and-go. Departures on the take-off roll, seen from the control tower. Try this Take off, circle left over the bay and then fly the Runway 31 approach through Lei Yue Mun to land.
xz: 而家你除咗降落 31 號跑道，仲可以由 31 號跑道起飛。自由飛行多咗一個起點，喺跑道九龍灣嗰一頭，機頭向住九龍城。 314° 跑道航向 31 號跑道 150 節 拉機頭 先推滿油門 揀「31 號跑道起飛」 喺設定畫面，喺自由飛行隔離揀 31 號跑道起飛 。你會對正 31 號跑道開始，塔台亦會批准你喺呢條跑道起飛。推滿油門，約 150 節拉機頭，然後收起落架。九龍城就喺正前方，所以要爬升同向左轉。 夜晚對正 31 號跑道，前面就係九龍。 同一個機場，鏡像方向 其他飛機都跟 31 號跑道：離港航班對正後向西北起飛，抵港航班由東面降落，等候航道嘅飛機移去東南面。無線電通話同閒談都用 31 號跑道。自由飛行嘅降落仍然會評分，亦可以落地再復飛。 由控制塔睇離港航班起飛滑行。 試吓 起飛後喺海灣上空向左盤旋，然後飛 31 號跑道進場穿過鯉魚門降落。
a: Night view of a 747-400 lined up on Runway 31 with the runway lights ahead and the lights of Kowloon beyond.
az: 夜晚 747-400 對正 31 號跑道，前方係跑道燈同遠處九龍嘅燈光。

t: New: a take-off lesson for first-time pilots
tz: 新增：俾初學者嘅起飛教學
d: Fly Kai Tak now has a Take-off lesson: a coach panel walks first-time pilots through a Runway 13 take-off in eight steps with live meters and plain-language tips.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 新增起飛教學：教練面板分八步帶初學者喺 13 號跑道起飛，有實時量表同淺白提示。
k: Kai Tak take-off lesson tutorial beginner flight simulator onboarding
x: Never flown a plane, even in a game? Fly Kai Tak now has a Take-off lesson. A coach panel walks you down Runway 13 one step at a time, shows what each control does, and moves on by itself when you get it right. A player asked for exactly this, so there is now a way to learn the take-off before you try the famous approach. 8 Steps full thrust to autopilot 150 kt Rotate speed all four aircraft 2,000 ft Climb target then autopilot Pick it on the start screen Choose Take-off lesson under Mode, pick any aircraft, and press Start the lesson. You begin lined up on Runway 13 in the exterior view, so you can watch the nose lift. Take-off lesson is the first choice under Mode. Eight steps Welcome. The four moves of a take-off in plain words. The flaps are already set for you. Full thrust. Hold E , or slide the thrust lever, until it reads 100%. Stay on the centre line. Tap ← → to steer while the speed builds to 150 kt. Rotate. Hold ↓ to lift the nose to 10 to 12°, then let go. Wheels up. Press G . Flaps up. Press V twice once the speed passes 190 kt. Climb to 2,000 ft. Keep the nose steady over Kowloon Bay. Autopilot. Press Z and let the computer hold your height, speed and heading. Step 4: the nose angle meter shows the 10 to 12° target in green. The coach watches you Each step has a live meter (thrust, speed, nose angle or altitude) with the target marked, and the control to use pulses on screen. If something goes wrong, the panel tells you in plain words: Drifting left or right of the centre line, and which way to steer. Nose too high or too low after lift-off. A stall warning, or wings that need levelling. A late rotation: it tells you to pull back if you pass 172 kt on the runway. Step 5: airborne, with the Gear button highlighted. On a phone, the same steps use the on-screen yoke, thrust lever and buttons. After the lesson The last card lets you keep flying with the autopilot on, or start the IGS 13 approach. Skip lesson is on screen the whole time and drops you into free flight. If you crash, the result card adds a tip for what went wrong, and the rewind buttons bring the coach back to the right step. Take-off complete, with the autopilot flying at 2,250 ft. Next The lesson covers the take-off only. Landing is still the IGS 13 approach, and the autopilot can fly that for you too. A landing lesson is the natural follow-up.
xz: 從來未揸過飛機，連遊戲都未玩過？Fly Kai Tak 而家有起飛教學。畫面會有一個教練面板，帶你喺 13 號跑道一步一步行，講解每個操控有咩用，你做啱咗就會自動跳去下一步。有玩家提出過呢個要求，所以而家可以先學起飛，再去挑戰出名嘅進場。 8 步驟 由推滿油門到自動駕駛 150 節 拉機頭速度 四款機型都一樣 2,000 呎 爬升目標 然後用自動駕駛 喺開始畫面揀 喺「模式」揀 起飛教學 ，揀一款機，然後㩒「開始教學」。你會喺機外視角，對正 13 號跑道開始，可以睇住機頭點樣抬起。 起飛教學係「模式」入面嘅第一個選擇。 八個步驟 歡迎。 用淺白嘅說話講起飛四個動作。襟翼已經幫你設定好。 推滿油門。 按住 E ，或者將推力桿推上去，直至顯示 100%。 保持喺中線。 速度加到 150 節期間，輕按 ← → 轉向。 拉機頭。 按住 ↓ ，將機頭抬到 10 至 12°，然後放手。 收起落架。 按 G 。 收襟翼。 速度過咗 190 節之後，按兩下 V 。 爬升到 2,000 呎。 喺九龍灣上空保持機頭穩定。 自動駕駛。 按 Z ，等電腦保持高度、速度同航向。 第 4 步：機頭角度計用綠色標出 10 至 12° 嘅目標。 教練會睇住你 每一步都有實時量表（推力、速度、機頭角度或者高度），目標位置有標示，要用嘅操控會喺畫面上閃動。有咩問題，面板會用淺白嘅說話提你： 偏離跑道中線，同埋應該向邊度轉。 離地後機頭太高或者太低。 失速警告，或者需要拉平機翼。 太遲拉機頭：喺跑道上過咗 172 節，就會叫你即刻拉桿。 第 5 步：已經離地，起落架按鈕有亮框提示。 用手機玩嘅話，同樣嘅步驟會用螢幕上嘅操縱桿、推力桿同按鈕。 教學完成之後 最後一張卡可以揀繼續用自動駕駛飛行，或者開始 IGS 13 進場。「Skip lesson」全程都喺畫面上，㩒咗就即刻轉入自由飛行。如果撞機，結果畫面會加一個提示講邊度出錯，而倒帶掣會將教練帶返去啱嘅步驟。 起飛完成，自動駕駛喺 2,250 呎飛行。 下一步 教學只包括起飛。降落仍然係 IGS 13 進場，自動駕駛都可以幫你飛。降落教學就係好自然嘅下一步。
a: The Take-off lesson welcome panel above a 747 lined up on Runway 13 at Kai Tak, with a Start the lesson button.
az: 起飛教學嘅歡迎面板，下面係一架停喺啟德 13 號跑道起點嘅 747，有「Start the lesson」按鈕。

t: Fix: no more false "too low" calls after take-off
tz: 修正：起飛後唔會再有錯誤嘅「太低」警告
d: Fly Kai Tak fix: the "Too low, gear" and "Too low, flaps" warnings no longer fire on take-off. They need a descent now; the IGS 13 approach is unchanged.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 修正：「Too low, gear」同「Too low, flaps」警告唔會再喺起飛時響，要下降先會觸發；IGS 13 進場冇變。
k: Kai Tak GPWS too low gear take-off bug fix free flight
x: After take-off, the ground proximity warning could shout "Too low, gear" the moment you raised the landing gear, and "Too low, flaps" while you were still climbing out with take-off flaps. Both calls are wrong on a take-off. They now only sound when you are descending. 200 fpm Descent needed for the gear and flap calls 0 False calls on a normal take-off Same IGS approach calls unchanged What was wrong The two calls checked height and configuration only. Close to the runway, with the gear up (below 500 ft) or with flaps under setting 3 (below 250 ft), they fired whether you were going up or down. In free flight, a normal climb-out set them off, and the first call also came with an amber warning on the display. The gear coming up on a 777 climb-out. No warning. What changed The "Too low, gear" and "Too low, flaps" calls now need a descent of more than 200 feet per minute. On the IGS 13 approach they work exactly as before, because you are always descending there. Terrain, sink rate, glideslope, bank angle and stall warnings are unchanged. The fix matters most for the new Take-off lesson, where raising the gear is a step of its own. What did not change Flying with no input still ends in a crash, and the autopilot still lands in every weather preset, in all four aircraft.
xz: 起飛之後，近地警告系統有時會喺你一收起落架就大叫「Too low, gear」，或者你仲用緊起飛襟翼爬升嗰陣叫「Too low, flaps」。起飛時呢兩個警告都係錯嘅。而家只會喺你下降時先會響。 200 fpm 需要嘅下降率 起落架同襟翼警告 0 誤報 正常起飛時 不變 IGS 進場 警告同以前一樣 問題喺邊 呢兩個警告只睇高度同機身設定。喺跑道附近，起落架收起（低過 500 呎），或者襟翼低過 3 格（低過 250 呎），無論你係上升定下降都會觸發。喺自由飛行入面，正常爬升都會觸發，而第一次警告仲會喺顯示器出現琥珀色字樣。 777 爬升時收起落架，冇警告。 改咗啲咩 「Too low, gear」同「Too low, flaps」而家要下降率大過每分鐘 200 呎先會響。 喺 IGS 13 進場，因為你一直下降，所以同以前完全一樣。 地形、下沉率、下滑道、坡度同失速警告都冇變。 呢個修正對新嘅起飛教學最重要，因為收起落架係其中一個獨立步驟。 冇變嘅嘢 唔做任何操作仍然會撞機，自動駕駛喺所有天氣設定、四款機型都仍然可以降落。
a: A 777 climbing out over Kowloon Bay with the gear coming up and no warning on the display.
az: 777 喺九龍灣上空爬升，起落架收緊，顯示器冇任何警告。

t: New: ground vehicles on the Kai Tak apron
tz: 新增：啟德停機坪地勤車輛
d: Fly Kai Tak adds airport ground vehicles: buses, catering trucks that lift to the door, baggage tractors with loaded carts, container and box freight trucks, and fire tenders at a fire station.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 新增機場地勤車輛：巴士、可升降到機門嘅餐飲車、拖住行李車嘅拖車、貨櫃同箱式貨車，以及消防局嘅消防車。
k: Kai Tak apron ground vehicles buses catering baggage fire
x: The apron is no longer empty. Vehicles now serve the six parked aircraft, and a fire station and cargo shed stand beside the runway. What is new Buses pull up to the front door and wait, then drive back to the depot. Catering trucks drive to the stand and lift their box up to the door. Baggage tractors tow three loaded carts under the wing. Container and box freight trucks loop around the cargo shed, and a lorry shuttles along the service road. The fire station holds crash tenders and a rescue vehicle. One tender drives out to a standby point and back. At night the vehicles show headlights, tail lamps and beacons. A bus and a catering truck at the front door of a parked 747. A baggage tractor towing three loaded carts under the wing of a parked aircraft. Container trucks beside the cargo shed. Fire tenders and a rescue vehicle outside the fire station. The apron at night with tail lamps and beacons lit. What did not change The vehicles run on the sim clock, so rewind and fast-forward still work. The autopilot still lands in every weather preset, and flying with no input still ends in a crash.
xz: 停機坪而家唔再空蕩蕩。地勤車輛會服務六架停泊嘅飛機，跑道旁邊亦有消防局同貨倉。 有咩新嘢 巴士會駛到前門等候，然後返車廠。 餐飲車駛到停機位，將車箱升起到機門。 行李拖車喺機翼下面拖住三架載滿行李嘅車。 貨櫃車同箱式貨車喺貨倉周圍行駛，另有一部貨車喺服務道路來回。 消防局有消防車同救援車，其中一部會駛去候命位置再返嚟。 夜晚車輛會亮起車頭燈、尾燈同閃燈。 一架停泊嘅 747 前門旁邊有巴士同餐飲車。 一部行李拖車拖住三架載滿行李嘅車，喺停泊飛機嘅機翼下面。 貨倉旁邊嘅貨櫃車。 消防局外面嘅消防車同救援車。 夜晚嘅停機坪，尾燈同閃燈亮起。 冇改嘅嘢 車輛跟模擬時鐘行動，所以倒帶同快進仍然有效。 自動駕駛仍然可以喺所有天氣設定下降落，完全唔操作仍然會墜毀。
a: A bus and a catering truck with its box raised at the front door of a parked 747.
az: 一架停泊嘅 747 前門旁邊有一部巴士同一部升起車箱嘅餐飲車。

t: New: easterly approach to Runway 31
tz: 新功能：31 號跑道東面進場
d: Fly Kai Tak adds a Runway 31 approach: a straight-in final over the sea, through the Lei Yue Mun gap and across Kowloon Bay, with its own lights, PAPI, radio calls, traffic and spotter view.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 加入 31 號跑道進場：喺海面直線進場，穿過鯉魚門，橫過九龍灣，有專屬燈光、PAPI、無線電、交通同觀機視角。
k: Kai Tak Runway 31 Lei Yue Mun easterly approach night landing
x: Runway 13 is not the only way into Kai Tak. When the wind swung round to the east, aircraft landed on Runway 31 instead: straight in over the sea, through the Lei Yue Mun gap and across Kowloon Bay. Fly Kai Tak now has that approach, day or night. 314° Final heading on the runway line 2,700 ft Start height about 8 NM out 3.1° Glidepath same as Runway 13 Pick Runway 31 approach On the setup screen, choose Runway 31 approach next to the IGS 13 approach. You start over the sea east of Kowloon, lined up with the runway. There is no turn to fly: hold the glidepath through the Lei Yue Mun channel between the hills, cross the bay low over the water and land. Heading for the Lei Yue Mun gap, about 3 km from the threshold. The runway is the strip beyond the bay. Lights over the water Runway 31 has its own approach lights across Kowloon Bay, with a crossbar and sequenced lead-in strobes, and its own PAPI beside the runway. The weather works as before, except that the wind is turned around so the approach is into the wind. The same gap at night, with the city lit on both sides. Short final at night. Keep the PAPI at two white, two red. Radio, traffic and views Approach now clears you for a visual approach, runway 31 and asks you to report Lei Yue Mun in sight, then Tower clears you to land. The other aircraft use Runway 31 too: departures take off to the north-west and arrivals line up behind you. There is a new Plane Spotter view at Lei Yue Mun (key C cycles to it on this runway) to watch jets squeeze through the gap. The Lei Yue Mun spotter view. Try this Fly it at night in clear weather. Keep the lights centred through the gap, then the PAPI steady as the runway rises out of the bay. Landings are scored and graded as on Runway 13.
xz: 啟德唔止 13 號跑道一條路。風向轉咗東面，飛機就降落 31 號跑道：喺海面直線進場，穿過鯉魚門，橫過九龍灣。Fly Kai Tak 而家加入咗呢個進場，日夜都飛得。 314° 最後進場航向 對正跑道 2,700 呎 起始高度 距離約 8 海里 3.1° 下滑道 同 13 號跑道一樣 揀「31 號跑道進場」 喺設定畫面，喺 IGS 13 進場隔離揀 31 號跑道進場 。你會喺九龍以東海面開始，已經對正跑道。唔使轉彎：守住下滑道，穿過兩邊山丘之間嘅鯉魚門海峽，低飛橫過海灣，然後降落。 飛向鯉魚門，距離跑道頭約 3 公里。海灣對面嗰條就係跑道。 海面上嘅燈光 31 號跑道有自己嘅進場燈，橫過九龍灣，有橫排燈同順序閃光燈，跑道旁邊亦有自己嘅 PAPI。天氣同之前一樣，不過風向會反轉，令你係頂風進場。 夜晚嘅同一個缺口，兩邊都係城市燈光。 夜間短五邊。PAPI 要保持兩白兩紅。 無線電、交通同視角 進場台而家會批准你「visual approach, runway 31」，叫你報告見到鯉魚門，然後塔台批准降落。其他飛機都用 31 號跑道：離港航班向西北起飛，抵港航班喺你後面排隊。仲有新嘅觀機視角「鯉魚門」（喺呢條跑道按 C 可以切換到），睇飛機擠過缺口。 鯉魚門觀機視角。 試吓 揀晴天夜晚。穿過缺口時保持燈光喺中間，跑道由海灣浮現時守住 PAPI。降落評分同 13 號跑道一樣。
a: Night approach to Runway 31 through the Lei Yue Mun gap, with city lights on both sides and the runway lights ahead.
az: 夜間穿過鯉魚門進場 31 號跑道，兩邊係城市燈光，前方係跑道燈。

t: Update: a High scores button on the home screen

The high score table opened from the home screen. It shows the top ten landings with each rank, callsign, score, aircraft and weather. The panel stays open or closed the way you left it, and Esc closes it. See the high score table post for how ranks work.
xz: 主畫面左上角而家有 最高分 掣，喺 Blog 同語言切換旁邊。㩒一下打開榜單，再㩒一下就收埋。 喺主畫面打開最高分榜。 面板會顯示頭十次降落，包括官階、呼號、分數、機型同天氣。面板會記住你上次嘅開關狀態，㩒 Esc 就可以收埋。官階點計，請睇 最高分榜文章 。

t: New: share your score and report card
tz: 新增：分享你嘅成績同成績表
d: Fly Kai Tak's result screen now has share buttons for X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads and email, plus a downloadable report card image.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 嘅結果畫面而家有分享掣，可以分享去 X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp、Threads 同電郵，仲可以下載成績表圖片。
k: Kai Tak share score report card landing grade flight simulator social sharing
x: When a flight ends, the result screen now has a row of share buttons. Post your grade and score to X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp or Threads, send it by email, copy the text, or save the report card as an image to post anywhere. The result screen after a night landing, with the new share row under the flight buttons. What you can share X, Facebook, Reddit, WhatsApp, Threads. Each opens that site's post window with your result already written, for example the aircraft, grade, score, touchdown rate and rank, and a link to flykaitak.com. Email. Opens a new message with the same text. Copy. Puts the text and link on your clipboard. Save image. Downloads the report card as a 1200 x 630 PNG, the size social sites show best. Share… On phones and other devices with built-in sharing, this sends the report card image and text straight to any app you choose. The report card The image carries your grade, score out of 100, your high score rank and callsign (for hand-flown IGS 13 landings), the touchdown stats, the aircraft, time of day and weather, all on the Kai Tak checkerboard. A crash or an abandoned approach gets a card too, so you can share those as well. The saved report card for a 747-400 landing: grade B, 88 out of 100, First Officer. Tip. Text and button labels follow the EN / 粵 toggle on the home screen, so the share text can go out in Cantonese too.
xz: 飛行完結之後，結果畫面而家有一排分享掣。你可以將評級同分數貼去 X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp 或者 Threads，用電郵寄出，複製文字，或者將成績表儲存做圖片，貼去任何地方。 夜間降落之後嘅結果畫面，飛行掣下面係新增嘅分享掣。 可以分享啲咩 X、Facebook、Reddit、WhatsApp、Threads。 每個掣都會打開該網站嘅發文視窗，內容已經寫好，例如機型、評級、分數、接地速率同官階，仲有 flykaitak.com 連結。 Email。 打開一封新電郵，內容一樣。 複製。 將文字同連結複製到剪貼簿。 儲存圖片。 下載 1200 x 630 嘅 PNG 成績表，呢個尺寸喺社交網站顯示得最好。 分享… 喺手機同其他有內置分享功能嘅裝置上面，可以將成績表圖片同文字直接傳去你揀嘅 App。 成績表 圖片上面有你嘅評級、100 分滿分嘅分數、高分榜官階同呼號（手動飛 IGS 13 降落先有）、接地數據、機型、時間同天氣，背景係啟德嘅棋盤。撞機或者放棄進場都有成績表，所以都可以分享。 一次 747-400 降落嘅成績表：評級 B，88 分（滿分 100），副機師。 小提示。 文字同掣嘅標籤會跟返主畫面嘅 EN / 粵 切換，所以分享文字都可以用廣東話發出。
a: The result screen after a night landing on Runway 13, with grade B, the touchdown stats and a row of share buttons.
az: 夜間降落 13 號跑道之後嘅結果畫面，有評級 B、接地數據，同一排分享掣。

t: New: a high score table with Captain and First Officer ranks
tz: 新功能：最高分榜，設機長同副機長官階
d: Fly Kai Tak now has a high score table. Land the IGS 13 approach by hand to rank as Captain, First Officer, Second Officer, Flight Engineer or Cadet.
dz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有最高分榜。親手降落 IGS 13 進場，就可以獲得機長、副機長、第二副機師、飛行機械師或見習機師官階。
k: Kai Tak high score leaderboard ranks Captain First Officer IGS 13 flight simulator
x: Fly Kai Tak now keeps a high score table . Land the IGS 13 approach by hand and your score goes on the board, with a rank that depends on how well you flew it. The result screen shows your rank, your position and the top five. Ranks Every landing is scored out of 100 for touchdown rate, touchdown point, centreline, bank and airspeed. The score sets the rank, and the table is sorted by score. Captain: 90 and above First Officer: 76 to 89 Second Officer: 60 to 75 Flight Engineer: 45 to 59 Cadet: below 45 What counts Only hand-flown landings in the IGS 13 approach mode are ranked. A landing with the autopilot switched on at any point, or after a rewind, still gets its grade but is not added. Crashes are not scored. Your callsign and where it is kept Type a callsign of up to 12 characters on the result screen and press Enter. It is remembered for next time. The table is saved in your browser, so it is still there after you close the tab. The top ten also show on the home screen under High scores . The top ten on the home screen, from Captain down to Cadet. The table is per browser for now. The repository includes a small Cloudflare Worker and D1 database that can make it one shared table for every player.
xz: Fly Kai Tak 而家有 最高分榜 。親手降落 IGS 13 進場，分數就會上榜，官階就睇你飛得幾好。 結果畫面會顯示你嘅官階、排名同頭五名。 官階 每次降落都會按接地速率、接地位置、中線偏差、傾側角同空速計分，滿分 100。分數決定官階，榜單按分數排序。 機長： 90 分或以上 副機長： 76 至 89 分 第二副機師： 60 至 75 分 飛行機械師： 45 至 59 分 見習機師： 45 分以下 幾時計分 只有喺 IGS 13 進場 模式親手駕駛嘅降落先會上榜。途中開過自動駕駛，或者倒帶之後降落，仍然會有評級，但唔會加入榜單。墜機唔計分。 呼號同儲存位置 喺結果畫面輸入最多 12 個字元嘅呼號，然後㩒 Enter，下次會記住。榜單儲存喺你嘅瀏覽器，閂咗分頁都仲喺度。頭十名亦會顯示喺主畫面嘅 最高分 入面。 主畫面嘅頭十名，由機長排到見習機師。 榜單暫時係每個瀏覽器各自一份。倉庫入面有一個細小嘅 Cloudflare Worker 同 D1 資料庫，可以變成所有玩家共用一張榜。
